scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Just a second! You're
carrying too many items
right now. You'd better
put your stuff in Kafra
Storage or you won't be
able to pick up anything new...
scripts.translation:
[範特]
等一下！你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
最好把東西存進卡普拉倉庫，
否則你將無法拾取任何新物品...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Hi there, welcome
to my pub. So what
would you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[範特]
你好，歡迎光臨我的酒館。
那麼，您想喝點什麼？

scripts.text: Beer, please.
scripts.translation: 來杯啤酒

scripts.text: A cocktail, please.
scripts.translation: 來杯雞尾酒

scripts.text: Soju, please.
scripts.translation: 來杯燒酒

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 稍後再說

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Alright, let me get
you a glass of beer on
tap. There you are, this
is out special Schwaltz Beer.
scripts.translation:
[範特]
好的，讓我給您倒一杯生啤。
給您，這是我們特製的施瓦茨啤酒。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Gulp gulp gulp*^000000

[{0}]
Ahhh, it's really
good! That really
hits the spot!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，真好喝！
真是讓人滿足！

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I'm sorry, but I have to
deliver all of our cocktail
ingredients to other customers.
Maybe I'll have enough to make
you something next time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[範特]
抱歉，我必須把所有雞尾酒原料
都提供給其他顧客。
也許下次我會有足夠的材料
為您調變一杯，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
S-soju? I'm sorry,
but we don't serve that
here. It's too much of
a tough guy drink for me...
scripts.translation:
[範特]
燒...燒酒？抱歉，
我們這裡不供應那種酒。
對我來說，那太像硬漢喝的酒了...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure, just take
your time, relax,
and order something
when you're ready.

當然，請慢慢來，放鬆一下，
想好了再點單。

也許下次我會有足夠的材料

S-soju? I'm sorry,
but we don't serve that
here. It's too much of
a tough guy drink for me...
scripts.translation:
[範特]
燒...燒酒？抱歉，
我們這裡不供應那種酒。
對我來說，那太像硬漢喝的酒了...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, did you overhear?
I'm sorry, it's just that one
of my employees had an
accident and was pretty hurt,
so I have nodoby that can
deliver this merchandise.
scripts.translation:
[範特]
哦，被你聽到了？
抱歉，只是我的一名員工
出了事故，傷得很重，
所以我現在沒有人手
可以運送這批貨物。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I have an urgent order
that I need to send to
the Kiel Hyre Academy,
but I can't find anyone
that's available for this
kind of temporary job.
scripts.translation:
[範特]
我有一筆緊急訂單
需要送到基爾·海爾學院，
但我找不到任何人
能勝任這種臨時工作。

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that
scripts.translation: 聽到這個我很遺憾

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Well, I'm sure that I'll
figure something out.
Do you know anyone
that'd be interested in
some part time work?
scripts.translation:
[範特]
嗯，我相信我會想出辦法的。
你認識對兼職工作
感興趣的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Really? That's great!
But first, I think it's fair to
tell you that this job may not
be as simple as you'd think.
I expect you to complete the
delivery, no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[範特]
真的嗎？太好了！
但首先，我覺得有必要告訴你，
這份工作可能沒有你想的那麼簡單。
我期望你無論如何都要完成配送任務。

scripts.text: Sure I'll do it
scripts.translation: 當然，我會做的

scripts.text: Wait, let me think about it...
scripts.translation: 等等，讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
I'm glad to hear that.
Well then, please take this
bottle of Culinary Wine to
Mrs. ^ff0000Lecollane^000000 in the Kiel
Hyre Academy. I'll pay you
once you finish the job, okay?
scripts.translation:
[範特]
太好了。
那麼，請把這瓶酒店的酒
送到基爾·海爾學院的
^ff0000勒科蘭夫人^000000那裡。
等你完成工作後，我會付你報酬的，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure thing. I really need
to get this done, so if you
can't do it, but know any
capable, responsible
people that can, then please
tell them about my situation.
scripts.translation:
[範特]
沒問題。我真的很需要儘快完成這件事，
如果你做不了，但認識任何有能力、
負責任的人，請把我的情況告訴他們。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Sure, just take
your time, relax,
and order something
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[範特]
當然，請慢慢來，放鬆一下，
想好了再點單。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Please deliver that bottle
of Wine I gave you to Mrs.
Mrs. ^ff0000Lecollane^000000, who should be
inside the Kiel Hyre Academy.
Hurry and get it to her before she
can complain about the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[範特]
請把我給你的那瓶酒
送到基爾·海爾學院裡的
^ff0000勒科蘭夫人^000000那裡。
快點送過去，別讓她因為配送問題抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, you're back.
Thanks for making that
delivery. Just give me
a moment, and then I can
pay you in zeny, okay?
scripts.translation:
[範特]
哦，你回來了。
謝謝你的配送。請稍等片刻，
我馬上用Zeny付你報酬，好嗎？

scripts.text: I need more wine...
scripts.translation: 我需要更多的酒...

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Oh, you need to deliver
another bottle? Alright,
let me look around, and
I'll give you the wine
and your payment.
scripts.translation:
[範特]
哦，你還需要送另一瓶？
好的，讓我找找看，
我會把酒和你的報酬給你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFRummage Rummage^000000
^3355FFRummage Rummage^000000

[Vandt]
There you go!
Thank you so much
for helping me out~
scripts.translation:
[範特]
給你！
非常感謝你的幫助~

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Hey, thanks a lot
for helping me out that
last time. I knew I asked
you out of the blue, but
you ended up being a life
saver! I really appreciate it!
scripts.translation:
[範特]
嘿，非常感謝你上次的幫助。
我知道我是突然找你幫忙，
但你真是救了我一命！
我真的很感激！

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
You're a really good
worker, you know that?
Dependable, responsible,
willing to help others, and
proactive too! I think you'll
go far in life, kid, I really do~
scripts.translation:
[範特]
你真是個好工人，你知道嗎？
可靠、負責、樂於助人，
而且很主動！我覺得你以後
會很有出息的，孩子，我真的這麼認為~

scripts.text:
[Vandt]
Arrrggghhh...
This can't be good...
This isn't good at all!
What am I suposed to do?
scripts.translation:
[範特]
啊...啊...
這不對勁...
這完全不對勁！
我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Fresh, crunchy toast!
If you want some, come
and get some tooooast~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
新鮮酥脆的吐司！
如果你想要，快來買吐司吧~

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Fresh, crunchy toast!
If you want some, come
and get some tooooast~
Oh! Hi hi~ Did you want
to buy some yummy toast?
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
新鮮酥脆的吐司！
如果你想要，快來買吐司吧~
哦！你好你好~你想買美味的吐司嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Would you please go to
the Lighthalzen Windmill
and tell them that Cezu needs
lots of flour and lots of eggs!
Then, bring all the stuff over
to me as soon as you can~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
請你去裡希塔樂鎮的風車磨坊，
告訴他們塞祖需要很多面粉和很多雞蛋！
然後，儘快把所有東西帶給我~

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Hey, you're back with the
ingredients! Thank you so
much, I really needed these!
Now please give this flour
and these eggs to Elly, and
send her my regards. See you~
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
嘿，你帶著食材回來了！
非常感謝，我真的很需要這些！
現在請把這些麵粉和雞蛋給艾莉，
並代我向她問好。再見~

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Hot, fresh and
cruuuunchy toast!
Come and get some!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
熱乎乎、新鮮又酥脆的吐司！
快來買吧！

scripts.text: I'm here for Elly
scripts.translation: 我是來找艾莉的

scripts.text: No, thanks
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Oh, I see. Elly must have
wasted another batch of
ingredients again. Well,
she's a regular customer,
so I really want to help, but
I can't really do anything.
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
哦，我明白了。艾莉肯定又浪費了一批食材。
嗯，她是個常客，
我真的很想幫忙，但我真的無能為力。

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
You see, I just ran
out of ingredients too!
But I can't really leave
to get some more. What if
people need to buy toast?
Listen, can you help me out?
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
你看，我的食材也剛好用完了！
但我實在走不開去買新的。
萬一有人來買吐司怎麼辦？
聽著，能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Would you please go get
some flour and eggs for me
from the ^3355FFLighthalzen Windmill^000000
Then, when you come back, I can
divide the ingredients, and you
can deliver some to Elly.
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
請去^3355FF裡希塔樂鎮的風車^000000幫我買些麵粉和雞蛋。
等你回來，我把食材分好，
你就可以把那份送給艾莉了。

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
I know that I'm basically
making you do everything
on your own, but please try
to understand that my hands
are tied. D-don't ask me
why, they just are!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
我知道這基本上是在讓你一個人忙前忙後，
但請體諒一下，我確實身不由己。
別...別問我為什麼，反正就是這樣！

scripts.text:
[Cezu]
Okay okay~
Please come again!
scripts.translation:
[塞祖]
好的好的~
歡迎下次再來！

scripts.text:
Hot, fresh and
cruuuunchy toast!
Come and get some!
scripts.translation:
熱乎乎、新鮮又酥脆的吐司！
快來買吧！

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, you've got too much
stuff on you right now. 
Put your junk in Kafra Storage
if you expect me to give you
anything. That's why you came
here to the miss, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[米爾斯]
嘿，你現在身上帶的東西太多了。
想讓我給你東西，先把你的破爛存進卡普拉倉庫。
你大老遠跑來找我，不就是這個原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, whaddya want?
I'm pretty busy right
now, so you mind coming
back later? Then we'll talk.
scripts.translation:
[米爾斯]
嘿，你要什麼？
我現在挺忙的，
你介意稍後再來嗎？到時候我們再談。

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Hey, whaddya want?
You just happened to
catch me at a good time,
but if you need anything,
you'd better spit it out quick
before things get hectic again.
scripts.translation:
[米爾斯]
嘿，你要什麼？
你來得正好，我剛好有空，
但如果你有什麼事，
最好趁現在趕緊說，
不然一會兒又要忙起來了。

scripts.text: I'm here for Cezu
scripts.translation: 我是來找塞祖的

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Oh, Cezu from the
toast stand? Okay,
I've got everything
that kid needs right
here. There's eggs inside,
so be really careful with it.
It's ready for you...
scripts.translation:
[米爾斯]
哦，是賣吐司攤的塞祖啊。
好的，
那個小孩需要的東西我這兒都有。
裡面有雞蛋，所以拿的時候小心點。
給你備好了...

scripts.text:
[Mills]
Kid's one of my regular
customers, so you don't
have to pay me, or run any
extra errands on my end. Yeah,
I know how other people treat
you adventurers. Well, see ya.
scripts.translation:
[米爾斯]
那小孩是我的常客，
所以不用付錢，也不用在我這兒跑腿。
嗯，我知道其他人是怎麼對待你們這些冒險者的。
好了，再見。

scripts.text:
[Mills]
......
Um, okay, well, if
you need something,
just hollar, I guess.
Cuts, Cutz where are you?
You'd better not be goofing off!
scripts.translation:
[米爾斯]
......
嗯，好吧，
如果你需要什麼，
就喊一聲吧。
庫茨，庫茨，你在哪？
你最好別在偷懶！

scripts.text:
[Mills]
That Cutz is such
a lazy rascal. The guy
thinks he can fool around
when he's on the clock...!
Ah well, he knows I can't find
a better assistant. He'll learn...
scripts.translation:
[米爾斯]
那個庫茨真是個懶鬼。
這傢伙以為上班時可以隨便玩...！
唉，反正我也找不到更好的助手了。他會學的...

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Man, why are we
always so busy?
Why does Mills have
to work me to the bone?
Eh, it's a living, I suppose...
scripts.translation:
[庫茨]
天哪，為什麼我們總是這麼忙？
為什麼米爾斯要把我累死累活？
呃，不過這也是為了生計吧...

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Wh-what makes you
think I'm goofing off,
Mills? L-look, look,
my hands are moving,
I'm busy, I'm working!
scripts.translation:
[庫茨]
你...你怎麼認為我在偷懶，
米爾斯？看...看，
我的手在動，
我很忙，我在幹活！

scripts.text:
[Cutz]
Hey, you're from
Cezu's toast stand,
right? How is cute
little Cezu doing?
scripts.translation:
[庫茨]
嘿，你是從
塞祖的吐司攤來的吧？
那個可愛的塞祖最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
Oh, I wish I could study
at the Kiel Hyre Academy...
All of the graduates get
really nice jobs! I'm almost
jealous of the students!
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
哦，我真希望能去
基爾·海爾學院讀書...
那裡的畢業生都能找到很好的工作！
我都快羨慕那些學生了！

scripts.text: Kiel Hyre Academy?
scripts.translation: 基爾·海爾學院？

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
Oh, the Kiel Hyre Academy
is a school founded by Kiel
Hyre, an inventor that became
rich from his strange machines.
He decided to give back to society
by building this private academy.
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
哦，基爾·海爾學院是由基爾·海爾創立的。
他是一位發明家，靠那些奇怪的機器發了財。
他決定回饋社會，於是建立了這所私立學院。

scripts.text:
[Hanie]
However, the school will
only accept orphans that are
too poor to enroll in any other
schools. Sometimes, it makes
me wish that I was an orphan too!
Well, not really, but you know...
scripts.translation:
[哈妮]
不過，這所學校只接收
窮得讀不起其他學校的孤兒。
有時候，我真希望自己也是個孤兒！
嗯，其實也不是啦，你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
I'm sorry, but if you aren't
associated with this institution,
then you're not authorized to
enter the ^FF0000Kiel Hyre Academy^000000.
Please leave if you don't have
an appointment with the staff.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很抱歉，如果您與本院無關，
則無權進入^FF0000基爾·海爾學院^000000。
如果沒有預約，請離開。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
I'm sorry, but if you aren't
associated with this institution,
then you're not authorized to
enter the ^FF0000Kiel Hyre Academy^000000.
Please leave if you don't have
an appointment with the staff.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很抱歉，如果您與本院無關，
則無權進入^FF0000基爾·海爾學院^000000。
如果沒有預約，請離開。

scripts.text: I'm here for a delivery.
scripts.translation: 我是來送貨的。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
You're here to deliver
something? Okay, just give
me the recipient's ^FF0000name^000000,
followed by the ^FF0000item^000000 being
delivered, and I'll verify it
before letting you inside.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
你是來送貨的？好的，請告訴我收件人的^FF0000姓名^000000，
以及所送^FF0000物品^000000的名稱，
我會核實後再讓你進去。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
You're here to deliver some
Wine to...to who? What was
the name? I...I don't think
we have anybody in the
academy named {0}
scripts.translation:
[保安]
你是來送...酒給誰？
叫什麼名字？我...我想學院裡
沒有叫{0}的人。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
So you're here to make
a delivery to Mrs. Lecollane?
What is it you've brought for
her? Some ^3355FF{0}^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保安]
所以你是來給勒科蘭夫人送貨的？
你給她帶了什麼？是^3355FF{0}^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Let me buzz her first,
and check to make sure
that she's been expecting
you. Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[保安]
讓我先通知她一下，
確認她是否在等你。
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Huh. Mrs Lecollane
is expecting a delivery,
but not the item that you
say that you've brought for
her. You might want to check
to see if there's been a mixup...
scripts.translation:
[保安]
嗯。勒科蘭夫人確實在等送貨，
但並不是你說的那件物品。
你最好檢查一下是否搞錯了...

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Alright....
So you're here to
deliver a bottle of
Wine to Mrs. Lecollane?
Let me buzz her, and get
this confirmed real quickly.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
好的....
所以你是來給勒科蘭夫人
送一瓶酒的？
讓我通知她，
馬上確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Okay, everything looks
good. Mrs. Lecollane
has been expecting you.
I guess you can enter.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
好的，一切正常。
勒科蘭夫人一直在等你。
我想你可以進去了。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
If you don't have
an appoointment, then
don't loiter around in
front of the academy!
scripts.translation:
[保安]
如果沒有預約，
就不要在學院門口逗留！

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Oh, did you have
other business inside
the academy? I remember
you from before, so there
shouldn't be any problems
letting you back inside...
scripts.translation:
[保安]
哦，你還有其他事要進學院嗎？
我記得你，之前來過，
所以讓你再進去應該沒問題...

scripts.text:
[Laci]
Oh, wow! We usually
don't get visitors on
campus! Um, you're not
a new faculty member, are you?
scripts.translation:
[拉西]
哇！我們很少見到
校外的人呢！嗯，
你不是新來的老師吧？

scripts.text:
[Laci]
Hey, Nesha...!
have you heard why
Aaci hasn't been coming
to class for awhile?
scripts.translation:
[拉西]
嘿，內莎...！
你聽說阿西為什麼
最近沒來上課嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
That's right, I haven't
seen Aaci in awhile.
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[桂內莎]
是啊，我好久沒見阿西了。
發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laci]
It's because....
Aaci saw a freakin' ghost!
It's one hundred percent
true! I heard about it from,
well, you know, my sources.
scripts.translation:
[拉西]
那是因為....
阿西看到了幽靈！
百分之百是真的！
我是從...你知道的，
我的訊息來源那裡聽說的。

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
...Wha...?
Oh, come on,
get outta town.
scripts.translation:
[桂內莎]
...什...麼？
拜託，
別開玩笑了。

scripts.text:
[Gui Nesha]
Aren't we a little
old to be talking about
this kind of stuff? You
know, rumors and ghost
stories that make no sense?
C'mon, Laci, knock it off!
scripts.translation:
[桂內莎]
我們是不是有點大了，
還聊這種話題？
你知道的，那些毫無根據的
謠言和鬼故事？
拜託，拉西，別鬧了！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Is there a problem?
Outsiders are not allowed to come
in here, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[勒科蘭夫人]
有問題嗎？
外人不得入內，請離開。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Oh, hello. Ah!
have you come to
deliver my wine? The
security guard called and
mentioned you were coming.
scripts.translation:
[勒科蘭夫人]
哦，你好。啊！
你是來送我的酒的吧？
保安剛才打電話說
你要來。

scripts.text: Yes, that's right!
scripts.translation: 是的，沒錯！

scripts.text: Er, s-sorry!
scripts.translation: 啊，對...對不起！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Well, you've come a little
later than I thought, but
I suppose it can't be helped.
I guess the waiting has just
heightened my anticipation
for this bottle of wi--
scripts.translation:
[勒科蘭夫人]
嗯，你來得比我預想的要晚一些，
不過我也沒辦法。
我想，等待反而讓我
對這瓶酒——

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Cling! Crrrack!*^000000

[Mrs. Lecollane]
Elly? Elly did you
break something again?!
You've got to be more careful!
If you don't finish baking those
cookies by the end of today, your
semester grades will suffer!
scripts.translation:
[勒科蘭夫人]
艾莉？艾莉，你又
把什麼東西弄壞了？！
你得小心一點！
如果你今天結束前不烤完那些餅乾，
你的學期成績就要受影響啦！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
B-but I just...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但...但是我只是...

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
^FF0000Elly^000000!!

[Elly]
......
Yes, Mrs. Lecollane.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
......
好的，勒科蘭夫人。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
*Ahem* Excuse me.
Would you please leave
the wine over there? You
may go now, and please
don't wander needlessly
around the academy.
scripts.translation:
[勒科蘭夫人]
*咳* 抱歉。
請把那瓶酒放在那邊好嗎？
你可以走了，請別在學院裡
到處亂逛。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Lecollane]
Hm...?
I guess I must
be mistaken. I'm
sorry, I thought you
were somebody else.
scripts.translation:
[勒科蘭夫人]
嗯...？
我想我一定是
認錯人了。抱歉，
我剛才以為你是別人。

scripts.text:
[Mrs Lecollane]
Well, our business is
completed, so would you
please leave the campus
as soon as you can? *Sigh*
I can't believe our future
is in these girls' hands...
scripts.translation:
[勒科蘭夫人]
嗯，既然事情辦完了，
請儘量快點離開校園吧？*嘆氣*
真不敢相信我們的未來
竟然寄託在這些孩子身上...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but would you
put some of your things in
your Kafra Storage first or
something? I can't really
help you when you're 
carrying so much stuff.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
抱歉，你能不能先把一些東西
存到卡普拉倉庫裡？
你拿著這麼多東西，
我實在幫不了你。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
W-wah! Oh...!
^333333*Phew*^000000 That was close,
I almost dropped them 
again! Why do I have so much
trouble handling ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哇！啊...！
^333333*呼*^000000 好險，
差點又掉下來了！
為什麼我處理食材總是這麼困難？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh no, what should
I do? ^333333*Sob*^000000 Wh-what
am I going to do? ^333333*Sniff*^000000
What happened?
scripts.translation: 發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I... I have to finish baking
this batch of cookies by the
end of today, but then I spilled
all of the ingredients on the
floor. I don't know how I can
bake those cookies now...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我...我今天結束前必須烤完
這批餅乾，但我把食材全都
灑在地上了。我不知道現在
還能不能烤出那些餅乾...

scripts.text: What can I do to help you?
scripts.translation: 我能幫你做什麼？

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so sorry.
scripts.translation: 哦，真對不起。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
What was that...?
You'll really help
me? That's wonderful!
Thank you! Thanks so much!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
剛才...？
你真的願意幫我？
太好了！
謝謝你！太感謝了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Wait, you don't go
to this school, don't
you? Y-you're one of
those adventurers, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
等等，你不是
這所學校的學生，對吧？
你...你是那些冒險者之一，對嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah, that's right.
scripts.translation: 是的，沒錯。

scripts.text:
Listen, I know you
probably have your own
plans, but do  you think
you can help me with this
huge problem that I have?
scripts.translation:
聽著，我知道你
可能也有自己的計劃，
但你能不能幫我
解決這個巨大的難題？

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Decline
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
How Wonderful!
Thank you! Thank you
so much! I'm supposed to
finish baking this batch of
cookies soon, but I spilled
all of the ingredients...
scripts.translation:
太好了！
謝謝你！太感謝了！
我本來馬上就要
烤完這批餅乾了，
可是我把所有材料都灑了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm outta here.

[Elly]
W-wait...!
Come back, you
d-don't...! I really
need some help!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
等...等等...！
回來，你...你...！
我真的需要幫忙啊！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, I guess the only way
I can bake these cookies is
to get some new ingredients.
I'm sorry to be such a burden,
but if you didn't offer to help
me, then I'd have no one to ask!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
看來，想要烤好這些餅乾，
只能去買新的材料了。
真抱歉給你添麻煩了，
但如果你不答應幫我，
我就沒人可以求助了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You don't understand how
important it is that I bake
these cookies... If I don't
finish this assignment, then
Mrs. Crank will fail me for
the entire semester!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你不知道烤好這些餅乾
對我有多重要... 如果我
完不成這個作業，
暴躁太太會讓我
整個學期都不及格！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Okay, I need to calm
down. I think I can do
this with your help.
Would you please do me
this huge favor and bring
all of these ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
好了，我得冷靜一下。
我覺得有你的幫忙
應該沒問題。
能請你幫個大忙，
把這些材料都帶給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Let's see... You can
get Wine from a pub in
Juno, Cacaos from hunting
Yoyos, and you can get flour
and Eggs from the girl that
runs the Toast Stand in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
讓我想想... 你可以在
朱諾的酒館買到葡萄酒，
打溜溜猴可以獲得可可豆，
麵粉和雞蛋可以在朱諾
那個經營吐司攤的女孩那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Good luck, getting
everything, and I hope
you hurry back here with
those cookie ingredients
as quickly as you can, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
祝你好運，希望你能
儘快把這些餅乾材料
帶回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
*Sob*...

[Elly]
Let's see, would you
like me to remind you
which ingredients I need?
Please bring these things as
soon as you can so that I can
quickly bake some cookies~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
讓我想想，你想讓我
再提醒你一下
需要哪些材料嗎？
請儘快把這些東西帶給我，
這樣我就能馬上
開始烤餅乾了~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Let's see... You can
get Wine from a pub in
Juno, Cacaos from hunting
Yoyos, and you can get flour
and Eggs from the girl that
runs the Toast Stand in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
讓我想想... 你可以在
朱諾的酒館買到葡萄酒，
打溜溜猴可以獲得可可豆，
麵粉和雞蛋可以在朱諾
那個經營吐司攤的女孩那裡買到。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hooray! Finally, I have
everything I need! This is
great! Oh, would you please
give me a moment while I bake
these cookies?  It shouldn't take
long, so hold on just a bit.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
萬歲！終於
集齊所有材料了！
太棒了！哦，請你
給我一點時間
烤這些餅乾好嗎？
應該很快就好，
請稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Tadah! I did it!
They're finally done!
Elly's special cookies.
I'd like you to have some
as thanks for helping me out.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
噹噹！成功了！
終於烤好了！
艾莉特製餅乾。
為了感謝你的幫忙，
我想請你嚐嚐。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but I was so
preoccupied with baking
these cookies that I didn't
even ask for your name. I'm
^FF0000Ellyja^000000, but everybody calls me,
''Elly.'' What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
真抱歉，我剛才太專注於
烤餅乾了，竟然忘了
問你的名字。我是
^FF0000艾莉嘉^000000，但大家都叫我
“艾莉”。你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
{0}?
...that name! It's wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
{0}？
...那個名字！真好聽！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I'm sorry, but I have
another favor to ask you
if you don't mind helping
me out again. Don't worry,
you won't have to hurry as
quickly as you did last time.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
真抱歉，如果你不介意
再幫我的話，我還有
另一個請求。別擔心，
這次你不用像上次那樣
那麼著急。

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼？

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm pretty busy...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我有點忙...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You know how you helped
me bake those cookies?
It's the first time I was able
to do it without burning them!
I just know Grandfather'd
be so proud of me!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你知道你幫我烤餅乾的事嗎？
那是我第一次
沒有把餅乾烤焦！
我敢肯定祖父
會為我感到驕傲的！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I really want Grandfather
to taste the cookies I baked,
but the cookies will be stale
by the time I'm able to leave
campus. Would you deliver these
cookies to my grandfather for me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我真的很想讓祖父
嚐嚐我烤的餅乾，
但等我離開校園時，
餅乾可能就不新鮮了。
你能幫我把這些餅乾
送給我的祖父嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, {0}!
Thank you so much, I knew
you'd understand! Would you
please bring the cookies to
him at ^FF0000Kiel Hyre's cottage^000000?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，{0}！
太感謝你了，我就知道你會理解的！
請幫我把餅乾送到^FF0000基爾·海爾的別墅^000000好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, right! They're really
careful about visitors and
keeping strangers off the
property, but if you mention
my name, they'll let you in.
Alright then, see you~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，對了！他們對訪客和陌生人進入領地非常嚴格，
但如果你提到我的名字，他們就會讓你進去。
那麼，再見啦~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, um...
Okay, I'm sorry to
have bothered you...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，那個...
抱歉打擾你了...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, um...
Okay, I'm sorry to
have bothered you...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，那個...
抱歉打擾你了...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, you don't know where
to find Kiel Hyre's cottage?
It's just north from this
academy. Please deliver my
cookies to Grandfather, and
let him know I really miss him.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，你不知道基爾·海爾的別墅在哪裡嗎？
它就在這所學院的北邊。
請把我的餅乾送給祖父，
並告訴他我很想念他。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hm? Grandfather's not
home? That's strange, he
didn't mention anything about
any business trips. I thought
he'd be at home all day...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯？祖父不在家？
這很奇怪，他並沒有提到
要去出差。我以為
他今天會一直在家...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Would you go back to his
cottage one more time? Here,
you can use this Cottage Key.
That way, you can just go
inside and talk to him~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你能再去他的別墅一次嗎？
給你，你可以用這把別墅的輔助鑰匙。
這樣你就可以直接進去和他說話了~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
That's so weird...
I thought Grandfather
said that he'd be at
home all day today...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
這也太奇怪了...
我以為祖父說過
他今天會一直在家...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hmm...?
What's this,
a letter for me?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯...？
這是什麼，
一封給我的信？

scripts.text:
^3355FFElly opened the envelope
and started reading the letter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾莉拆開信封，開始讀信。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333Dearest Elly,
 
I have something to discuss
with my son Kiehl, so I am
leaving to meet with him.
If you don't hear from me
after 7 days after I've written
this letter, then you must
escape the academy as soon
as possible, and retrieve
something inside our 
cottage's study.
 
If you have a friend you
can trust, please ask him
to follow my traces in the
cottage. I might be in danger,
and in dire need of rescue.
 
Elly, don't trust anyone
in the academy, even your
classmates, since they may
be influenced by Kiehl.
 
Be careful, and I love you.
 
--Grandpa^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333親愛的艾莉：

我有些事要和我的兒子基爾商量，
所以我要出發去見他。
如果你在我寫完這封信後的7天內
沒有收到我的訊息，
你必須儘快逃離學院，
並取回我們別墅書房裡的某樣東西。

如果你有一個可以信任的朋友，
請讓他沿著我在別墅留下的痕跡尋找。
我可能有危險，
急需救援。

艾莉，不要相信學院裡的任何人，
即使是你的同學，
因為他們可能受到了基爾的影響。

小心，我愛你。

--爺爺^000000

scripts.text:
[Elly]
What? Oh no, it's been
ten days since he wrote
this letter! Ah, does this
mean that he's in danger?!
Oh no, what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
什麼？天哪，他寫這封信已經十天了！
啊，這難道意味著他有危險？！
天哪，我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: About your grandpa
scripts.translation: 關於你爺爺的事

scripts.text: Tell me about Kiehl
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於基爾的事

scripts.text: What's with this academy?
scripts.translation: 這所學院是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh! My grandfather is
Kiel Hyre, founder and
CEO of the Kiel Hyre
foundation. He looks
strict and cold hearted,
but he's actually very nice!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦！我的祖父是基爾·海爾，
基爾·海爾基金會的創始人兼CEO。
他看起來嚴厲且冷酷，
但實際上非常和藹！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We're not related by
blood, but he's taken
care of me ever since
I lost my parents. Oh,
Grandapa, where are you?
I'm getting so worried!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我們並沒有血緣關係，
但自從我失去父母后，
他一直照顧我。哦，
爺爺，你在哪裡？
我好擔心！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Kiehl? That's my
grandfather's son...
I don't know him that
well, and only saw him
once at an academy event.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
基爾？那是我祖父的兒子...
我不太瞭解他，
只在學院的一次活動上見過他一次。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Mmm, he's a good looking
guy with pale skin, silver
hair, and this cold, fierce
stare. A lot of my classmates
worship Kiehl because he's
also a business genius~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，他是個長相英俊的男人，
皮膚白皙，銀髮，
眼神冰冷而銳利。
我的很多同學都很崇拜基爾，
因為他也是個商業天才~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
It's weird though...
I have no idea why my
grandpa and Kiehl don't
get along. They're both
really good at what they do...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不過很奇怪...
我不知道為什麼
爺爺和基爾關係不好。
他們倆在各自領域
都做得非常出色...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, I know the security
here is really tight, but
that's because everything
here is so luxurious and
expensive, you know~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，我知道這裡的
安保非常嚴密，
但那是因為這裡的一切
都極其奢華昂貴，
你知道的~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
We also have a very
special curriculum where
you learn more of what you
want. Personally, I want to
become a great career woman
like ^0000FFMs. Allysia^000000. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我們還有非常特別的
課程體系，
你可以更多地學習
自己感興趣的內容。
就我個人而言，
我想成為像^0000FF艾莉西亞女士^000000那樣
出色的職業女性。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elly]
This place certainly
isn't like other schools.
Yeah, everything is made to
fit each of the student's needs.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
這裡確實
不像其他學校。
是的，這裡的一切
都是為了滿足
每位學生的需求而設立的。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Recently, though?
Some really weird stuff
has been happening. All of
my classmates are afraid of
going out alone by themselves.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
不過最近？
發生了一些非常奇怪的事情。
我的同學們都害怕
獨自外出。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But I'll be okay!
You'll be there to
rescue me from danger,
right, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但我沒問題的！
你會在那裡
把我從危險中救出來，
對吧，{0}？

scripts.text: Who is Ms. Allysia?
scripts.translation: 艾莉西亞女士是誰？

scripts.text: Strange incidents?
scripts.translation: 奇怪的事件？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Oh, Ms. Allysia is
Grandfather's secretary~
She's so beautiful, and
my grandfather really
trusts her with everything!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
哦，艾莉西亞女士
是爺爺的秘書~
她非常美麗，
而且爺爺非常信任她，
把一切都交給她！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Well, {0}...
I'm not supposed to tell
anyone outside of the school,
but I can trust you! You see...
We're haunted by a ghost!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
嗯，{0}...
我不應該告訴
學校以外的人，
但我可以信任你！你看...
我們被幽靈纏上了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I know it sounds crazy,
but this ghost wanders the
campus, and curses its victims,
making them so cold and lifeless.
It happened to my roommate,
Mayo. It's like she's a statue...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我知道這聽起來很瘋狂，
但這個幽靈在校園裡遊蕩，
詛咒它的受害者，
讓他們變得冰冷且毫無生氣。
我的室友梅奧就發生了這種事。
她就像一尊雕像...

scripts.text:
[Elly]
I snuck into the medical
office to see her, and she...
She couldn't do anything!
What would happen if the
ghost decided to curse me?!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我偷偷溜進醫務室
去看她，結果她...
她什麼都做不了！
如果幽靈決定
詛咒我該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
You know what...?
If I ever got cursed
by that ghost, just yell
''^FF0000Wake up, Elly!^000000''
That'll wake me up for sure!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你知道嗎...？
如果我被那個幽靈詛咒了，
只要大喊
''^FF0000醒醒，艾莉！^000000''
肯定能把我叫醒！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Argh, I'm in a fix!
I have to finish my
homework before it's due!
Yeah, I've got to go see
Mrs. Lecollane now.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
啊，我遇到麻煩了！
我必須在截止前
完成作業！
是的，我現在得去
見勒科蘭夫人了。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Say, {0},
if it's okay, would you
please go find what my
grandpa left for me in
the ^FF0000cottage study^000000? You're
the only one I can trust!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
對了，{0}，
如果方便的話，
請去^FF0000小屋書房^000000
找找爺爺留給我的東西？
你是唯一讓我信任的人！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Anyway, I'll see you later
in the evening! Please come
by my ^FF0000dorm room^000000. Um, the
dorms are in the church just
behind the academy, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
總之，晚上見！
請去我的^FF0000宿舍房間^000000。
嗯，宿舍就在學院後面的
教堂裡，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
My room is in the back,
and it's on the ^FF0000second floor^000000
^FF0000on the left side^000000. Please use
a ladder to come up, okay?
I'll leave my window open
for you, so just come, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
我的房間在後面，
在^FF0000二樓^000000
^FF0000左側^000000。請爬梯子上來，好嗎？
我會把窗戶開著，
所以直接進來就好，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hurry, hurry, the
teacher's coming!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
快一點，快一點，
老師要來了！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Hurry, hurry, the
teacher's coming!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
快一點，快一點，
老師要來了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can see a curtain
decorated with a cute
design through the
window of this room,
which is probably
used by a young girl.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF透過這間房的窗戶，
可以看到掛著可愛圖案
窗簾的房間，
這大概是
一位年輕女孩的房間。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be Elly's room.
It doesn't sound like anyone
is inside, so she probably
isn't back yet. For now, you
should try to find what her
grandfather left for her
in their cottage's Study.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這一定是艾莉的房間。
裡面沒有聲音，
所以她可能還沒回來。
現在，你應該去
小屋的書房找找
她祖父留給她的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis slightly open window
must lead into Elly's room.
Although she asked you to
find a ladder to enter her
window, you probably won't
find one. You might be able
to climb up that water pipe...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這扇半開的窗戶
應該通向艾莉的房間。
雖然她讓你找梯子爬進窗戶，
但你大概找不到梯子。
也許可以爬那根水管上去...^000000

scripts.text: Climb Water Pipe
scripts.translation: 爬水管

scripts.text: Find Another Way
scripts.translation: 尋找其他方法

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou climbed up the
water pipe, and sneaked
into Elly's room successfully.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你爬上了水管，
成功潛入了艾莉的房間。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tried to climb
the water pipe, but
you ended up falling
and bumping your head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你試圖爬水管，
結果摔了下來，
撞到了頭。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere must be some
other way to get into
Elly's room, aside from
climbing up this water pipe...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF除了爬這根水管，
一定還有別的辦法
能進入艾莉的房間...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can't go up into
that open window.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你無法爬上
那扇開著的窗戶。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a second...
You're carrying too
many items with you
right now, so you'll
need to free up more
Inventory space first...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請稍等...
你現在攜帶的物品太多了，
需要先騰出一些
背包空間...^000000

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Who the heck are you?
Y-you're not supposed
to be able to get inside!
Get out of here right now!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
你到底是什麼人？
你...你不應該能進來的！
馬上給我出去！

scripts.text:
^3355FFElly seems to have
been cursed, and is
completely still and
lifeless. You've got to
try something, but what?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾莉似乎中了詛咒，
完全靜止不動，
毫無生氣。你必須
做點什麼，但是做什麼呢？^000000

scripts.text: Wake her up by shaking.
scripts.translation: 搖晃她試圖喚醒

scripts.text: Wake her up by yelling.
scripts.translation: 大聲呼喊試圖喚醒

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou grab Elly by the
shoulders, and try to get
her to respond by violently
shaking her entire body.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你抓住艾莉的肩膀，
用力搖晃她的身體，
試圖讓她做出反應。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Elly? Elly! No!
Come back to us!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
艾莉？艾莉！不！
回來吧！

scripts.text: ^3355FFElly's not responding...^000000

^3355FFAs soon as you said those
words, a ^000000Small Golden Key^3355FF
and a ^000000Button^3355FF drop from Elly's
hands. It looks like she woke
up, but only for an instant.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF就在你說出那些話的瞬間，
一把^000000小黃金鑰匙^3355FF
和一個^000000按鈕^3355FF從艾莉手中掉落。
看起來她醒了，
但只是一瞬間。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFElly's not responding...^000000

^3355FFAlright...
But sooner or later,
you should try to break
the curse placed on Elly.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF好吧...
但遲早，
你應該試著解除
艾莉身上的詛咒。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFMaybe the golden key^000000
unlocks something in the^000000
Cottage. Let's take another look.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許那把黃金鑰匙^000000
能開啟^000000小屋裡的什麼東西。
讓我們再仔細看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like Elly's
Golden Key might fit
into the keyhole on the
Grey Box you found inside
Kiel Hyre's Cottage.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看起來艾莉的
黃金鑰匙可能正好能插入
你在基爾·海爾的小屋裡
發現的那個灰色盒子的鎖孔中。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou successfully open the
Grey Box with the Golden Key,
and find a Blue Keycard, along
with a folded note, inside the
Grey Box. You quickly read
the note's contents...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你成功用黃金鑰匙打開了灰色盒子，
在盒子裡發現了一張藍色鑰匙卡片，
以及一封摺疊好的紙條。
你迅速讀完了紙條上的內容...^000000

scripts.text:
Dearest Elly,
Kiehl finally broke the taboo,
and tried to transform you guys
into something horrible.
^FFFFFF_^000000
By the time you read this,
my life is probably in danger.
Whether I live depends on you.
^FFFFFF_^000000
You'll already learn if you
meet Puppet, but I want to tell
you myself: you're not human.
You'll learn the details if you
enter the factory by using the
entrance near the grave next
to the church. Then, I want
you to find Allysia inside
the factory's secret room.
I've registered your name in
her security system, so don't
worry. Hopefully, Allysia will
then come to save me...
^FFFFFF_^000000
Sorry about that,
Grandpa
scripts.translation:
親愛的艾莉：
基爾終於打破了禁忌，
試圖把你們變成某種可怕的東西。
^FFFFFF_^000000
等你看到這封信時，
我的生命可能已經岌岌可危。
我能否活下來，就取決於你了。
^FFFFFF_^000000
如果你見到傀儡，
你大概已經知道了，
但我想親口告訴你：
你不是人類。
如果你使用教堂旁邊
墳墓附近的入口進入工廠，
你就會知道詳情。
然後，我想讓你在工廠的
秘密房間裡找到艾莉西亞。
我已經在她的安保系統中
登記了你的名字，所以別擔心。
希望艾莉西亞能來救我...
^FFFFFF_^000000
抱歉了，
爺爺

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
discovered the note
locked inside the Grey Box.
The following message was
written in the note by Elly's
grandfather, Kiel Hyre.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡就是你發現
鎖在灰色盒子裡的紙條的地方。
以下是艾莉的爺爺
基爾·海爾在紙條上寫的內容。^000000

scripts.text:
Dearest Elly,
Kiehl finally broke the taboo,
and tried to transform you guys
into something horrible.
^FFFFFF_^000000
By the time you read this,
my life is probably in danger.
Whether I live depends on you.
^FFFFFF_^000000
You'll already learn if you
meet Puppet, but I want to tell
you myself: you're not human.
You'll learn the details if you
enter the factory by using the
entrance near the grave next
to the church. Then, I want
you to find Allysia inside
the factory's secret room.
I've registered your name in
her security system, so don't
worry. Hopefully, Allysia will
then come to save me...
^FFFFFF_^000000
Sorry about that,
Grandpa
scripts.translation:
親愛的艾莉：
基爾終於打破了禁忌，
試圖把你們變成某種可怕的東西。
^FFFFFF_^000000
等你看到這封信時，
我的生命可能已經岌岌可危。
我能否活下來，就取決於你了。
^FFFFFF_^000000
如果你見到傀儡，
你大概已經知道了，
但我想親口告訴你：
你不是人類。
如果你使用教堂旁邊
墳墓附近的入口進入工廠，
你就會知道詳情。
然後，我想讓你在工廠的
秘密房間裡找到艾莉西亞。
我已經在她的安保系統中
登記了你的名字，所以別擔心。
希望艾莉西亞能來救我...
^FFFFFF_^000000
抱歉了，
爺爺

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a cookie
basket filled with
delicious cookies.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是一個裝滿了
美味餅乾的餅乾籃。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be
Elly's cookie basket.
There appears to be
a folded note wedged
between the cookies.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這一定是艾莉的餅乾籃。
看起來餅乾之間
夾著一封摺疊好的紙條。^000000

scripts.text: Read Note
scripts.translation: 閱讀紙條

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
{0}, help!
There's this guy dressed in
black who's walking around,
and casting this weird spell!
He's the one that's been making
people cold and lifeless as
puppets! I'm getting scared!
^FFFFFF_^000000
I hope you get this note...
He ran after me, but I locked
myself in my room. I'm going
to leave my window open so that
you can still find me. I hope he
doesn't cast his curse on me!
scripts.translation:
{0}，救命！
有個穿著黑衣的傢伙在四處遊蕩，
還施放著奇怪的魔法！
就是他讓人變得冰冷僵硬，
像傀儡一樣！我好害怕！
^FFFFFF_^000000
希望你能看到這封信...
他追著我跑，但我把自己鎖在房間裡了。
我會把窗戶開著，這樣你還能找到我。
希望他不要對我施下詛咒！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat note probably
wasn't written just
for you, anyway.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那封信本來
可能就不是專門寫給你的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese cookies aren't
stale yet, but they're no
longer warm. If they're
not at room temperature,
then they're a little cold.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這些餅乾雖然還沒變質，
但已經不再溫熱了。如果它們
不是室溫的話，那就有點涼了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you stare at the
cookie basket, the wind
from the window jostles
it, revealing a letter that
was placed underneath.
It was probably written
by Elly for you to read.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你凝視著餅乾籃時，
從窗戶吹進來的風使它晃動，
露出了下面放著的一封信。
那大概是艾莉寫給你看的。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333Dearest {0},
 
My teachers usually yell at me
since I make so many mistakes,
but today Mrs. Lecollane gave me
praise for my yummy cookies!
It's all thanks to you, my friend.
I'm very happy we've met:
you've taught me that there
are good people in the world.
And I know Grandpa will like
you, though, I don't know
where he could be...
 
Someday, I hope to become
as nice a person as you are.
Let's keep in touch and be
really good friends, okay?
 
Yours, Elly^000000
scripts.translation:
^333333親愛的{0}：
 
我的老師通常都會因為我犯很多錯誤而責罵我，
但今天勒科蘭夫人卻表揚了我做的餅乾很美味！
這都要感謝我的朋友，是你教會了我。
我很高興能遇見你：
你讓我知道世界上還有好人。
我知道爺爺也會喜歡你的，
雖然我不知道他現在在哪裡...
 
總有一天，我希望自己能變得像你一樣善良。
我們要保持聯絡，做真正的好朋友，好嗎？
 
你的，艾莉^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt feels like you can
still sense Elly's warmth
and kindness from her
cookie basket. You picked
out a cookie, and put it
in your mouth. It was
deliciously bittersweet.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF感覺你依然能從她的餅乾籃中
感受到艾莉的溫暖與善良。
你拿出一塊餅乾放入口中。
那味道苦中帶甜，十分美味。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
{1}
It's time to go back. I can't
stay here much longer.

^3355FFAll the cookies
in this basket are
stale! Well, it shouldn't
come as a surprise.
It's been a long time
since they were baked.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF籃子裡所有的餅乾
都變質了！嗯，這也不奇怪。
它們烤好已經很久了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just a grave.
It might be important
to you later, but now
it's not really all that
helpful to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這只是一座墳墓。
它以後對你可能很重要，
但現在對你並沒有太大幫助。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just a grave.
It might be important
to you later, but now
it's not really all that
helpful to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這只是一座墳墓。
它以後對你可能很重要，
但現在對你並沒有太大幫助。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a secret door
near this grave. It looks
like there's some kind of
slot and a number pad
installed on the door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這座墳墓附近有一扇秘密門。
看起來門上裝有某種插槽
和數字鍵盤。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhat should you
insert into the slot?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你應該把什麼
插入插槽中？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn electronic confirmation
chime sounds once you insert
the Yellow Keycard, followed by
an automated voice that asks:^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你插入黃色鑰匙卡片後，
電子確認音響起，
隨後是一個自動語音問道：^000000

scripts.text:
[Security System]
Please enter the password.
scripts.translation:
[安保系統]
請輸入密碼。

scripts.text:
[Security System]
Password confirmed.
Welcome, Kiel Hyre.
scripts.translation:
[安保系統]
密碼確認無誤。
歡迎，基爾·海爾。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou hear another 
pleasant beep, and
a secret path opens.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你聽到另一聲
悅耳的提示音，
一條秘密通道打開了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Security System]
Incorrect password.
Please try again.
scripts.translation:
[安保系統]
密碼錯誤。
請重試。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhatever you're trying
to insert into the slot
isn't working at all...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF無論你想把什麼
插入插槽，
都完全不起作用...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe door to the
factory is wide open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF工廠的大門
大敞著。^000000

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe secret entrance
has now been sealed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF秘密入口
現在已經被封鎖了。^000000

scripts.text:
As you aproach the
grave, it begins to
emit flashes of light.^000000
scripts.translation:
當你走近墳墓時，
它開始發出閃爍的光芒。^000000

一定是搞錯了。

scripts.text:

Well unless you have

think you'll be able to
meet with Mister Hyre.
scripts.translation:
[小屋看守]
好吧，除非你有預約，
否則我想你無法
見到海爾先生。

scripts.text:
[Cottage Keeper]
Goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[小屋看守]
再見。

^3355FFIt's just a wall.
It's not particularly
standing in your way.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這只是一堵牆。
它並沒有特別擋你的路。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe wall is now
open, revealing
a secret path.^000000

^3355FFcrammed with many^000000
^3355FFlarge, hardcover books^000000

^3355FFWithout thinking, you
reach for a book from
the bookshelf. As you
pull it towards you, the
wall slides opens open
to reveal a secret path.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你下意識地伸手從書架上抽出一本書。
當你把它拉向自己時，
牆壁滑開了，
露出了一條秘密通道。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis bookshelf is
crammed with many
large, hardcover books.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個書架上
塞滿了許多
厚重的精裝之書。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a minute...!
There's something on
the floor here, but you
can't pick it up since
you're carrying too
many items now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下...！
這裡地上有東西，
但你現在攜帶的物品太多了，
無法撿起來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a letter
on the floor. Naturally,
you pick it up, despite
the fact that it's not
addressed to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在地上發現了一封信。
儘管信上並沒有寫你的名字，
但你還是自然而然地把它撿了起來。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou entered the room.^000000

^FFFFFF##^000000*Tasty-Nutricious-Delicious*
*Cute Pet Doof Vending Machine*
The best food for your Cute Pets
that is superior to the Pet Food
you can buy in the market!
^FFFFFF_^000000
Price: 1,100 zeny (cheap!)
scripts.translation:
^FFFFFF##^000000*美味-營養-可口*
*可愛寵物笨蛋自動售貨機*
這是給你的可愛寵物的最佳食物，
比你在市場上買到的寵物飼料還要好！
^FFFFFF_^000000
價格：1,100 Zeny（很便宜！）

scripts.text: Buy!
scripts.translation: 購買！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, you
don't have enough
zeny to insert into
the vending machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF很遺憾，你的Zeny不足，
無法投入自動售貨機。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOh no...!^000000
^3355FF1,100 zeny seems kind
of expensive for Pet Food,
but if it's better than the
normal stuff, it might
be worth a shot.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕...！^000000
^3355FF1,100 Zeny對於寵物飼料來說
似乎有點貴，
但如果它比普通的好，
也許值得一試。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOh no...!
There's nothing
special about it
at all! It's just
normal Pet Food!
scripts.translation:
^3355FF糟糕...！
它根本沒有什麼特別之處！
這就是普通的寵物飼料！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis vending machine
seems really shady and
suspicious for some reason.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這臺自動售貨機
不知為何看起來非常可疑。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a box filled with
ripe, delicious apples.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一個裝滿
成熟美味蘋果的箱子。^000000

scripts.text: Take the box
scripts.translation: 拿走箱子

scripts.text: Leave it
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo...! Wait!
Something's wrong!
Whatever you do,
don't take this box!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不...！等等！
有什麼不對勁！
無論如何，
都不要拿走這個箱子！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAnd so, your inner
voice, your Jungian
shadow if you will,
prevented you from
taking the box.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF於是，你內心的聲音，
或者說你的榮格陰影，
阻止了你拿走箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomething is wrong
with this box of apples.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這箱蘋果有些不對勁。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA magnificent world map,
detailing the Rune-Midgarts
Kingdom, Schwarzwald Republic,
as well as another country to the
west whose name is unfamiliar
to you, is pasted to this wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF牆上貼著一張精美的大陸地圖，詳細描繪了盧恩·米德加茲王國、修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國，以及西邊一個你聞所未聞的國家。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the
world map more closely,
you find that something has
been hidden underneath it.^000000
^3355FFWhatever might be
hidden beneath this
map probably isn't
important enough for
you to investigate.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你仔細端詳這張世界地圖時，發現下面藏著什麼東西。^000000
^3355FF藏在地圖下面的東西，大概並不重要，不值得你去探究。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the
world map more closely,
you find that something has
been hidden underneath it.^000000
^3355FFUnfortunately, you can't
see what's under the map
since it's pasted to the wall.
You'll need to find some
way to loosen the glue
without damaging the map...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你仔細端詳這張世界地圖時，發現下面藏著什麼東西。^000000
^3355FF不幸的是，因為地圖貼在牆上，你無法看清下面是什麼。你需要想辦法在不損壞地圖的情況下，把膠水弄鬆...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you examine the
world map more closely,
you find that something has
been hidden underneath it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF當你仔細端詳這張世界地圖時，發現下面藏著什麼東西。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Examine
scripts.translation: 檢查

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou bring the pot of
steaming hot liquid
close to the world map.
As the paste on the wall
moistens, the map slowly
begins to peel back.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將那鍋滾燙的液體靠近世界地圖。隨著牆上的膠水受潮，地圖開始慢慢剝落。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe peeling map reveals
a folded piece of paper
hidden beneath it. You
take the paper, and smooth
the map out to adhere it to the
wall once again. A message is
written on the piece of paper.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF剝落的地圖露出了下面藏著的一張摺疊的紙。你取下那張紙，並將地圖撫平重新貼回牆上。紙上寫著一段文字。^000000

scripts.text:
^0000FFShe will be in a place
as cold as the poles.
When the well is dried
and the earth is cracked,
the path to her heart, a
heart as transparent as
crystal, will be open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^0000FF她將在如極地般寒冷的地方。
當井水乾涸，大地龜裂，
通往她內心的道路便會開啟，
那是一顆如水晶般透明的心。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFI'll have to fight four
snakes with four swords
to find her. The first sword
is love. The second sword
is despair. The third sword
is rage. The fourth sword is
hope. To find her, to rescue her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF我必須揮舞四把劍，與四條蛇戰鬥才能找到她。
第一把劍是愛，第二把劍是絕望，
第三把劍是憤怒，第四把劍是希望。
為了找到她，為了拯救她。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF...............................
The deeper meaning
of this poem, if it even
exists, eludes you.^000000

^3355FFThis is were you found
the paper on which the
poem was written. Perhaps
it would be a good idea to
refresh your memory and
read that poem again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡是你發現那張寫有詩篇的紙的地方。也許回顧一下記憶，再讀一遍那首詩是個好主意。^000000

scripts.text: Read
scripts.translation: 閱讀

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

The deeper meaning
of this poem, if it even
exists, eludes you.^000000

^3355FFThere's no need for
you to reread this poem.
You're a freakin' genius!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你不需要重讀這首詩。
你真是個天才！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a pot
filled with boiling,
steaming liquid.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一鍋沸騰冒煙的液體。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a pot
filled with boiling,
steaming liquid.
Steam... That you could
use to loosen the glue on
the map... You're a genius!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一鍋沸騰冒煙的液體。
蒸汽...你可以用它來軟化地圖上的膠水...你真是個天才！^000000

scripts.text: Try it.
scripts.translation: 試試看

scripts.text: That? That won't work!
scripts.translation: 那樣？那行不通！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou picked up the
boiling pot, but
slightly burned your
hands by accident.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拿起了那鍋沸騰的液體，
但不小心燙到了手。

scripts.text:
^3355FFNo, no...
We'd better try
something else.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不，不...
我們最好試試別的方法。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
picked up the pot filled
with steaming hot liquid.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡是你拿起那鍋沸騰冒煙液體的地方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat's a nice looking
calabash. You might even
get something from it...
But first you better get
rid of all your extra weight.
And by weight, I mean items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這葫蘆看起來很不錯。說不定能從中得到些什麼...
不過首先，你得減輕一些負重。
這裡的負重，指的是物品。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's an expensive
looking calabash--
or in less fancy
words, a ''gourd.''
Would do you do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是一個看起來很昂貴的葫蘆——
或者用通俗的話說，就是一個“葫蘆”。
你要怎麼做？^000000

scripts.text: Break Open Calabash
scripts.translation: 砸開葫蘆

scripts.text: Look Inside Calabash
scripts.translation: 檢視葫蘆內部

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can't break
open that calabash...
You're a hero, not a vandal.
Now, if this act of vandalism
can be considered an act of
heroism, then it'd be okay.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你無法砸開那個葫蘆...
你是英雄，不是破壞者。
不過，如果這種破壞行為可以被視為英雄主義的話，那倒也無妨。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tenderly place
your hand into the
calabash, and gently
feel around with your
fingers until you retrieve
an Old Bronze Key.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你溫柔地將手伸進葫蘆裡，
用手指輕輕摸索，直到取出一把破舊銅鑄鑰匙。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's probably
nothing inside anyway.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF裡面大概什麼都沒有吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the expensive
looking calabash from
which you've obtained
the Old Bronze Key.
It's useless to you now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這就是那個看起來很昂貴的葫蘆，
你從中獲得了破舊銅鑄鑰匙。
現在它對你來說已經沒用了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a fancy pool
filled with fresh water.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個精緻的池子，裡面裝滿了清水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a fancy pool
filled with fresh water,
along with a conscpicuous
lion statue with two handles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一個精緻的池子，裡面裝滿了清水，
旁邊還有一尊顯眼的獅子雕像，帶有兩個把手。^000000

scripts.text: Pull Handles
scripts.translation: 拉動把手

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
Which handle would
you like to pull first?
scripts.translation: 你想先拉動哪個把手？

scripts.text: Right Handle
scripts.translation: 右側把手

scripts.text: Left Handle
scripts.translation: 左側把手

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pull the right
handle, causing water
to gush out of the lion's
mouth. It looks pretty cool~^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你拉動了右側的把手，
水從獅子口中噴湧而出。看起來挺酷的~^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs soon as you pull the
left handle, the water in
the pool drains away. The
pool empties, and you can
see a layer of green moss
covering the pool's bottom.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你拉動左側的把手時，
池中的水迅速排空。池子變空了，
你可以看到池底覆蓋著一層綠色的苔蘚。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Investigate
scripts.translation: 調查

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide that
a pool is little more
than a hole without
any water to fill it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定，一個沒有水填充的池子，
不過就是一個坑罷了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you look through
the wet moss at the
bottom of the pool,
you stumble upon a
small, peculiar button.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你透過潮溼的苔蘚看向池底時，
你發現了一個小巧而奇特的按鈕。^000000

scripts.text: Press button
scripts.translation: 按下按鈕

scripts.text: Don't Press Button
scripts.translation: 不按按鈕

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou press the button,
which seems to trigger
a strange sound coming
from the stairs at the hallway.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你按下了按鈕，
似乎觸發了某種機關，
走廊盡頭的樓梯處傳來了奇怪的聲音。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not push
this button. Your enemies
must have hidden it carefully
for you to find: it must be
some sort of nefarious trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你最好不要按這個按鈕。
你的敵人一定把它藏得很隱蔽，
讓你發現它：這肯定是個
陰險的陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided not
to pull any handles.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定不去拉任何把手。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you pressed
the small button that caused
some strange sound to come
from the stairs near the hallway.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡就是你按下那個小按鈕的地方，
它導致走廊附近的樓梯處
傳來了奇怪的聲音。

scripts.text: *Grrr~*
scripts.translation: *嗚嗚~*

scripts.text:
^3355FFAn extremely vicious
looking dog is glaring
at you. Can you really
pass by this creature
without getting hurt?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一隻看起來極其兇惡的狗
正瞪著你。你真的能
不受傷地通過這隻生物嗎？^000000

scripts.text: March forward
scripts.translation: 向前進

scripts.text: Run away
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait! Perhaps you can
use food to soothe the
savage beast. Why don't
you feed it some of your Pet
Food and see what happens?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等！也許你可以
用食物來安撫這隻兇猛的野獸。
為什麼不餵它一些你的寵物飼料，
看看會發生什麼？^000000

scripts.text: Give Pet Food
scripts.translation: 給寵物飼料

scripts.text: It won't work!
scripts.translation: 沒用！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gingerly throw the
Pet Food towards the dog.
Its tail shakes violently as
it devours the food. You'd
better pass this dog now
while you have the chance!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心翼翼地朝狗扔去寵物飼料。
它的尾巴劇烈地搖動，
狼吞虎嚥地吃掉了食物。
趁現在有機會，你最好趕緊通過這隻狗！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou slowly approach
the dog, but it won't
stop snarling at you.
You try to run past the
dog, but it blocks all of
your moves. What to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你慢慢靠近那隻狗，但它
不停地對你咆哮。
你試圖從狗身邊跑過去，
但它擋住了你所有的路。怎麼辦？^000000

scripts.text:
[Vicious Dog]
BOW WOW!
BOW WOW!
BOW WOW WOW!
scripts.translation:
[兇惡的狗]
汪汪！
汪汪！
汪汪汪！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe dog chased you
downstairs like the
suckah chump you are.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那隻狗把你追到了樓下，
就像你是個笨蛋一樣。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFLet's get out of here!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF我們快離開這裡！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something inside
this drawer, but you can't
take it since you're carrying
to many items with you. Maybe
you should pay a visit to your
trusty Kafra Storage first.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個抽屜裡有些東西，但你拿不走，
因為你攜帶的物品太多了。也許
你應該先去你的卡普拉倉庫看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find an old drawer
^that has been closed.
^If you open it, then you
^might find something
^inside. Or could it be
^empty. Who knows?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現一箇舊抽屜
^它是關著的。
^如果你開啟它，那麼
^你可能會發現裡面
^有些東西。或者可能是
^空的。誰知道呢？^000000

scripts.text: Open Drawer
scripts.translation: 開啟抽屜

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou obtain a Yellow
Keycard from inside the
drawer. Opening that drawer
turned out to be worthwhile.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你從抽屜裡獲得了一張黃色鑰匙卡片。
開啟這個抽屜果然是值得的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFForget opening that
drawer. I mean, come on,
what would be the point?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF還是別開啟那個抽屜了。
我是說，拜託，
那有什麼意義呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you
found the Yellow Keycard.
This drawer is now empty.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這就是你找到黃色鑰匙卡片的地方。
這個抽屜現在是空的。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA solid box is laid
on the floor in which
a smaller, locked box
has been placed inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地板上放著一個結實的箱子，
裡面裝著一個較小的、上了鎖的箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA solid box is laid
on the floor in which
a smaller, locked box
has been placed inside.
Perhaps you can use your
Old Bronze Key to unlock it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF地板上放著一個結實的箱子，
裡面裝著一個較小的、上了鎖的箱子。
也許你可以用你的破舊銅鑄鑰匙開啟它。^000000

scripts.text: Use Old Bronze Key
scripts.translation: 使用破舊銅鑄鑰匙

scripts.text: No, it'll never work.
scripts.translation: 不，那肯定行不通。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYour hunch paid off!
The Old Bronze Key really
did unlock that box! You
open the inner box and
obtain the Green Keycard
that was locked inside.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你的直覺應驗了！
破舊銅鑄鑰匙真的打開了那個箱子！
你開啟裡面的箱子，
獲得了被鎖在裡面的綠色鑰匙卡片。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhat...?
What? Using a key
to unlock a lock?
Come on, that's
freakin' crazy talk!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什麼...？
什麼？用鑰匙開鎖？
拜託，這簡直是瘋話！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the box from
which you've obtained
the Green Keycard.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這就是你獲得綠色鑰匙卡片的箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne of the books on
this crammed bookshelf
is labeled with the note,
''To Elly.'' It must have been
left behind by her grandfather.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個塞得滿滿的書架上，
有一本書貼著標籤，
寫著“給艾莉”。
那一定是她的祖父留下的。^000000

scripts.text: Examine Book
scripts.translation: 檢查書籍

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou skim through the
book's pages, and don't
find anything particularly
interesting. However, you
notice a steel surface behind the
shelf as you place the book back.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你快速翻閱了書頁，
沒有發現什麼特別有趣的內容。
不過，當你把書放回去時，
你注意到書架後面有一塊鋼製表面。^000000

scripts.text: Examine the steel surface
scripts.translation: 檢查鋼製表面

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou remove more of the
shelf's books to reveal
that the steel surface is
part of a safe hidden behind
the bookshelf. There are two
keyholes on the steel safe.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你移開書架上更多的書，
發現那塊鋼製表面是
隱藏在書架後面的保險箱的一部分。
鋼製保險箱上有兩個鑰匙孔。^000000

scripts.text: Try all your keys
scripts.translation: 嘗試所有的鑰匙

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhich key will
you insert into
the first keyhole?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你要把哪把鑰匙
插入第一個鑰匙孔？^000000

scripts.text: Old Bronze Key
scripts.translation: 破舊銅鑄鑰匙

scripts.text: Cottage Key
scripts.translation: 別墅的輔助鑰匙

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhich key will
you insert into
the second keyhole?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你要把哪把鑰匙
插入第二個鑰匙孔？^000000

scripts.text: Old Bronze Key
scripts.translation: 破舊銅鑄鑰匙

scripts.text: Cottage Key
scripts.translation: 別墅的輔助鑰匙

scripts.text: Green Keycard
scripts.translation: 綠色的鑰匙卡片

scripts.text: Cottage Key
scripts.translation: 別墅的輔助鑰匙

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhich key will
you insert into
the second keyhole?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你要把哪把鑰匙
插入第二個鑰匙孔？^000000

scripts.text: Green Keycard
scripts.translation: 綠色的鑰匙卡片

scripts.text: Cottage Key
scripts.translation: 別墅的輔助鑰匙

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe safe opens with
a click, and you see
a Grey Box inside.
You take the Grey Box
with you, hoping that it
will come in handy later.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF保險櫃“咔噠”一聲打開了，
裡面有一個灰色的盒子。
你拿走了灰色的盒子，
希望它以後能派上用場。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe safe won't open.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF保險櫃沒有開啟。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's probably a better
idea to investigate the
cottage for the keys that
will open up this safe...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許更好的辦法是
去別墅裡找找能開啟
這個保險櫃的鑰匙...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou place the books
back on the bookshelf.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把書放回了書架上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can probably
find better clues
somewhere else
around here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你也許能在
附近的其他地方
找到更好的線索。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found a
bookshelf that's
crammed with books.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一個
塞滿書的書架。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are piles of papers
and books stacked on top
of the desk covering topics
like artificial power, Sage
Varmundt's research, factory
robotization, and magic scrolls...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF桌上堆滿了紙張和書籍，
內容涉及人造動力、
賢者瓦爾蒙特的研究、
工廠自動化以及魔法卷軸...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhile rummaging through
the books and papers, you
find a piece of paper with
the Kiel Hyre Foundation's
official seal. You decide that
it might come in handy someday.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在翻找書籍和紙張時，
你發現了一張蓋有
基爾·海爾基金會
官方印章的紙張。
你覺得它以後可能會有用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've obtained
a blank piece of
paper with the Kiel
Hyre Foundation seal.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了一張
蓋有基爾·海爾
基金會印章的空白紙張。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are piles of papers
and books, covering various
scientific and magic topics,
stacked on top of this desk.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這張桌子上堆滿了
紙張和書籍，涵蓋了
各種科學和魔法主題。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis medicine cabinet
is filled with bottles of
various colors. What kind
of medicine can be found here?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個藥櫃裡裝滿了
各種顏色的瓶子。
這裡能找到什麼樣的藥？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis medicine cabinet
is filled with bottles of
various colors. What kind
of medicine can be found here?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個藥櫃裡裝滿了
各種顏色的瓶子。
這裡能找到什麼樣的藥？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait, you have a blank piece
of paper with the Kiel Hyre
Foundation seal! It's strange
that the seal was put on a blank
piece of paper. Maybe something
is written on it with special ink?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等，你有一張蓋有
基爾·海爾基金會印章的
空白紙張！印章蓋在
空白紙張上很奇怪。
也許上面用特殊墨水
寫了什麼？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a crazy hunch, but
maybe, just maybe, you can
use something inside this
medicine cabinet that will
reveal any invisible ink
written on this document!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是一個瘋狂的念頭，
但也許，也許你可以
使用這個藥櫃裡的東西
來顯現出檔案上
用隱形墨水寫的字！^000000

scripts.text: What? That's crazy!
scripts.translation: 什麼？太瘋狂了！

scripts.text: Of course! Let's try it!
scripts.translation: 當然！試試看！

scripts.text:
^3355FFSorry.
I thought it
was a good idea...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF抱歉。
我以為這是個好主意...^000000

scripts.text: Try Red Liquid
scripts.translation: 嘗試紅色液體

scripts.text: Try Blue Liquid
scripts.translation: 嘗試藍色液體

scripts.text: Try Yellow Liquid
scripts.translation: 嘗試黃色液體

scripts.text: Try Green Liquid
scripts.translation: 嘗試綠色液體

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt works!
The blue liquid is
revealing small text
written on the paper.
It looks like some
kind of long poem...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF成功了！
藍色液體顯現出紙上寫著的細小文字。
看起來像是某種長篇詩篇...^000000

scripts.text:
[Poem]
The first snake is made of
steel, but I used my rage
to destroy it. The second
snake is made of magic,
but my love pierced its heart.
scripts.translation:
[詩篇]
第一條蛇由鋼鐵鑄成，
但我用怒火將其摧毀。
第二條蛇由魔法構成，
但我的愛刺穿了它的心臟。

scripts.text:
[Poem]
The third snake is flesh
and blood, but my hope
defeated it in the end.
However, the fourth and
final snake is formless, and
no one knows its appearance.
scripts.translation:
[詩篇]
第三條蛇由血肉組成，
但我的希望最終戰勝了它。
然而，第四條也是最後一條蛇
無形無相，無人知曉它的模樣。

scripts.text:
[Poem]
I cast my despair to the air,
but nobody knows if it killed
the snake. I am merely ^0000FFa little
lost devil^000000 with four swords and
four snakes, searching for that
girl in the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[詩篇]
我將絕望拋向空中，
但無人知曉它是否殺死了蛇。
我不過是^0000FF一個迷途的小惡魔^000000，
手持四把劍，面對四條蛇，
在黑暗中尋找那個女孩。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is a very
strange poem. What
could it possibly mean?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是一首非常奇怪的詩。
它到底意味著什麼？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNever mind.
This idea sounds
too crazy to work...
like puttting a man
on the moon. Can you
believe that hogwash?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF算了。
這個主意聽起來太瘋狂了，根本行不通...
就像把人送上月球一樣。你能相信這種胡話嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tried sprinkling
the {0} liquid from the
medicine cabinet onto
the blank paper with the
Kiel Hyre Foundation seal.
However, nothing happened...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你嘗試將藥櫃中的{0}液體
灑在帶有基爾·海爾基金會印章的空白紙張上。
然而，什麼也沒有發生...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is where you poured
some blue liquid to read
a poem written in invisible
ink on the blank piece of paper
with the Kiel Hyre Foundation
seal. Would you like read it?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在這裡倒了一些藍色液體，
閱讀了寫在帶有基爾·海爾基金會印章的
空白紙張上的隱形墨水詩篇。
你想再讀一遍嗎？^000000

scripts.text: No time!
scripts.translation: 沒時間了！

scripts.text: Read
scripts.translation: 閱讀

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're running out of
time! For now, it would
be best for you to search
every inch of this cottage.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你的時間不多了！
目前，最好先仔細搜查這間小屋的每一個角落。^000000

但我用怒火將其摧毀。
第二條蛇由魔法構成，
但我的愛刺穿了它的心臟。

and blood, but my hope
defeated it in the end.
However, the fourth and

no one knows it's appearance.

第三條蛇由血肉組成，
但我的希望最終戰勝了它。
然而，第四條也是最後一條蛇
無形無相，無人知曉它的模樣。

^3355FF小惡魔^000000，手持四把劍，面對四條蛇，

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are four elaborately
designed swords positioned
next to four creepy looking
snake sculptures.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有四把設計精美的劍，
擺放在四個看起來令人毛骨悚然的蛇形雕塑旁邊。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are four elaborately
designed swords positioned
next to four creepy looking
snake sculptures. Wait!
Perhaps they're related to
that poem you read earlier...
scripts.translation:
^3355FF有四把設計精美的劍，
擺放在四個看起來令人毛骨悚然的蛇形雕塑旁邊。等等！
也許它們和你之前讀到的那首詩有關...

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 絕對不行！

scripts.text: Of course!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
^3355FFImpossible...
It must be some
kind of coincidence...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不可能...
這一定是某種巧合...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOf course! And look!
There's a hole on top
of the head of each snake
sculpture. These holes seem
big enough to insert each of
the ornamental swords nearby...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF沒錯！你看！
每個蛇形雕塑的頭頂都有一個洞。
這些洞似乎足夠大，可以插入旁邊那些裝飾劍...^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Insert Ornamental Swords
scripts.translation: 插入裝飾劍

scripts.text:
^3355FFImposible...^000000
^3355FFIt must be some^000000
^3355FFkind of coincidence...^000000

^3355FFCan't... Pull out...
Sword! It must be
locked into place
somehow, or sealed
by some strange force!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF拔...拔不出來...
這把劍似乎被固定住了，
或者被某種神秘的力量封印了！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should probably
try to insert each sword
into the correct snake.
First, please select the
snake in which you will
insert the first sword.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你應該試著將每把劍
插入正確的蛇形雕塑中。
首先，請選擇
你要插入第一把劍的蛇。^000000

scripts.translation: 第一條蛇

scripts.translation: 第四條蛇

^3355FFNow, please choose
the snake in which you

scripts.translation:
^3355FF現在，請選擇
你要插入第二把劍的蛇。^000000

^3355FF接下來，請選擇

scripts.translation:
^3355FF最後，請選擇

scripts.text:
^3355FFYour ears are suddenly
filled with a low buzzing
noise, and your mind
and body feel as if they
are being swept away...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你的耳邊突然充滿了低沉的嗡嗡聲，
你的身心彷彿正在被席捲而去...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened...
You probably didn't
insert the swords into
the correct snakes. For now,
you should return the swords,
and then try this again later.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什麼也沒發生...
你大概沒有把劍插入正確的蛇中。
