yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
好的。
請自便。

scripts.text:
[Steward]
Ah, Master {0}.
It is a pleasure to
receive your company
once again. Would you
like to see my master, or...?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊，{0}大人。
再次見到您真是榮幸。
您想見見我的主人，還是...？

scripts.text: ^FF0000Kiel Hyre^000000
^3355FFMitchell^000000

[Steward]
Very well.
Right this way~
scripts.translation:
[管家]
好的。
請這邊走~

scripts.text:
[Steward]
Oh...? You must.
be here to deliver
good news. Excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
哦...？您一定是
來傳達好訊息的。
失禮了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Steward furtively^000000
^3355FFlooked around to check^000000
^3355FFif anyone is watching him.^000000

[Steward]
I believe it should
be safe enough to let
you go see him now...
Please, hurry this way.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我想現在應該
足夠安全，可以
讓您去見他了...
請，快這邊走。

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a second...
You're carrying too
many items with you
right now, so you'll
need to free up more
inventory space first...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請稍等...
您現在攜帶的物品太多了，
所以您需要先騰出
更多的物品欄空間...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Ah, you must be {0}.
I'd like to thank you for saving
my life. You must have many
questions to ask me, so I'll
do my best to give you answers.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
啊，你就是{0}吧。
我想感謝你救了我的命。
你肯定有很多問題想問我，
我會盡力回答你的。

scripts.text: Robots?
scripts.translation: 機器人？

scripts.text: ^FF0000Elly^000000's button?

[Kiel Hyre]
I've been researching
robotics for thirty-two
years now. I'm proud to
say that I've succeeded
where the great Sage
Varmundt did not.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我已經研究機器人技術三十二年了。
我很自豪地說，
我成功做到了偉大的賢者瓦爾蒙特未能做到的事。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
It's been my dream to
develop humanoid robots
from humans. Those Guardians
might be robots too, but they
don't operate using free will.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
開發類人機器人一直是我的夢想。
那些守衛可能也是機器人，
但它們並不具備自由意志。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
If you'd like to know more
of the specifics concerning
robotics, why don't you speak
with ^3355FFAllysia^000000? She can explain
everything much more succinctly
than I can. I tend to ramble...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
如果您想了解更多關於機器人技術的細節，
為什麼不和^3355FF艾莉西亞^000000談談呢？
她比我更簡潔地解釋一切。
我說話總是有點囉嗦...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
^3355FFKiehl^000000 is my only son,
but the love of my life
died after giving birth to
him. I'll admit that he's
a genius in mechanical
design and development.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
^3355FF基爾^000000是我唯一的兒子，
但我生命中的摯愛在他出生後不久就去世了。
我承認，他在機械設計和開發方面是個天才。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
He's largely responsible
for the creation of Third
Generation robots like Elly.
Unfortunately, he's trying to
modify his creations for
some sinister purpose.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
第三代機器人（如艾莉）的創造主要歸功於他。
不幸的是，他正試圖出於某種邪惡目的修改他的造物。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I tried to stop him,
but I ended up getting
locked inside the factory.
I don't know why he wants
to do this. I still have
absolutely no clue...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我試圖阻止他，
結果卻被鎖在了工廠裡。
我不知道他為什麼要這麼做。
我完全沒有任何頭緒...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
That button Elly was
holding has ^3355FFKiehl's emblem^000000
engraved on it. Ah, and that
man in black menacing the
students? That was probably
^3355FFKaiser^000000, Kiehl's bodyguard.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
艾莉拿著的那個按鈕上刻著^3355FF基爾的徽章^000000。
啊，還有那個威脅學生的黑衣人？
那大概是^3355FF凱撒^000000，基爾的保鏢。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kaiser...
I don't know
anything about him.
I've never even seen
his face! Kiehl just hired
him without letting me know...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
凱撒...
我對他一無所知。
我甚至從未見過他的臉！
基爾只是僱了他，沒有告訴我...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
If you don't have
anymore questions for me,
then would you please
let me rest?? I'm still not
feeling well from the time
I was locked up in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
如果您沒有其他問題想問我的話，
請讓我休息一下好嗎？
被鎖在工廠裡的那段時間讓我至今身體不適。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Ah, I almost forgot.
Please, take this as
a little reward for
saving my life.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
啊，我差點忘了。
請收下這個，
作為我救命的謝禮。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
If you don't have
anymore questions for me,
then would you please
let me rest?? I'm still not
feeling well from the time
I was locked up in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
如果您沒有其他問題想問我的話，
請讓我休息一下好嗎？
被鎖在工廠裡的那段時間讓我至今身體不適。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Hm? Did you
have something
that you wanted
to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
嗯？您有什麼
想問我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have enough
concrete evidence yet,
but I might have some
questions soon enough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我還沒有確鑿的證據，
但很快我可能就會有一些問題。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Ah, {0}.
It's you. So how can
I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
啊，{0}。
是你啊。今天有什麼
我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: About ^3355FFAllysia^000000...

[{0}]
You know, I was looking
through this deserted house
in Juno, and discovered
an old portrait of a woman
that looks just like Allysia.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道嗎，我在朱諾的一棟廢棄房子裡
發現了一幅舊畫像，
畫中的女子看起來和艾莉西亞一模一樣。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Oh...
Is that all?
I thought you had
a robotics question.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
哦...
就這？
我還以為你有機器人方面的問題。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Anyway, that's a
strange coincidence.
Well, I suppose it's
not so strange to find
look-a-likes for other people...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
總之，這是個奇怪的巧合。
不過，找到長得像別人的人
也不算太奇怪...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think it's just
a coincidence. The woman
in that thirty year old portrait
was also named Allysia, and she
worked at Orsimier street
in Juno. Does that ring a bell?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得這不僅僅是巧合。
那幅三十年前的畫像中的女子
也叫艾莉西亞，
她曾在朱諾的奧斯米爾街工作。
這聽起來耳熟嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then I thought that this
Allysia must have been the
woman that you loved, and
that you based your robot's
apperance on her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
然後我就想，
這個艾莉西亞一定是你深愛的女子，
而你的機器人
就是以她為原型設計的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think this is what happened:
when you were a young, poor
man, you fell in love with
Allysia. However, she was
in love with Rosimier, who
was rich and powerful.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得事情是這樣的：
當你還是個貧窮的年輕人時，
你愛上了艾莉西亞。
然而，她愛的是
富有且有權勢的羅西米爾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, Rosimier was
betrothed to some other
woman, and he ended up
marrying his fiancee, thus
breaking Allysia's heart.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，羅西米爾
已經與別的女子訂婚，
並最終娶了他的未婚妻，
從而傷了艾莉西亞的心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Feeling betrayed, her
heart broken, Allysia jumped
into a river. Then, you decided
to get revenge on Rosimier, so
you ended up joining
Rekenber Corporation!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感到被背叛、心碎欲絕的艾莉西亞
跳河自盡了。於是，你決定
向羅西米爾復仇，
所以最後加入了
雷肯貝爾公司！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Hahahahahahaha!
Oh, what an imagination~
That's very ridiculous...
Though, I admit, maybe
I did design Allysia after
seeing that woman long ago.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
噢，想像力真豐富~
這太荒謬了...
不過，我承認，
也許我確實是在
很久以前見過那個女人後，
才設計出了艾莉西亞。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I'd almost forgotten
about her! I think we
were friends... Though,
where did you get the idea
that I might have
been in love with her?
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我幾乎都忘了
她！我想我們
曾經是朋友... 不過，
你哪來的想法
認為我可能
愛過她？

scripts.text: Reveal Kiel's Portrait from Hut
scripts.translation: 展示小屋裡的基爾畫像

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wh-what...
How did...
Where did you...?
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
什...什麼...
你怎麼...
你從哪裡...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kiel Hyre, I found this
portrait of you as a young
man from the house of the
man that bought Allysia's ring.
I even spoke to the fisherman
that discovered Allysia's body.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
基爾·海爾，我在
買下艾莉西亞戒指的那位男子的
房子裡，發現了
這幅你年輕時的畫像。
我還和發現
艾莉西亞屍體的漁夫談過話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You paid an awful lot
of money to buy Allysia's
ring. How can you not tell
me that you didn't love her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你花了大筆的錢
買下艾莉西亞的戒指。
你怎麼能告訴我
你不愛她呢？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
*Sigh...*
You got me, you got me.
I didn't want you to learn
the truth. You are correct.
I loved Allysia, and designed
my robot to look just like her.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
*嘆息...*
你贏了，你贏了。
我不希望你知道真相。
你說得對。
我愛艾莉西亞，並設計
我的機器人長得和她一模一樣。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I could never forget her.
Ever. But I would never
do anything to harm the
Rosimiers! I'm a scientist!
I hated him when I was young,
but things are different now!
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我永遠不會忘記她。
永遠。但我絕不會
做任何傷害羅西米爾家族的事！
我是一名科學家！
我年輕時恨他，
但現在情況不同了！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I shed no tears when the
Rosimiers fell, but I wasn't
responsible. Besides, I didn't
have the resources or the
capability to cause it...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
當羅西米爾家族衰落時，
我沒有流下一滴眼淚，
但我也不負責任。況且，
我沒有資源也沒有能力
去造成這一切...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm afraid that the
evidence shows otherwise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
恐怕
證據顯示並非如此。

scripts.text: Reveal Portrait of Rosimiers
scripts.translation: 展示羅西米爾家族的畫像

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Take a good look
at this portrait that
I found at the Rosimiers'
old house. Do you see
anything... incriminating?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好好看看這幅
我在羅西米爾家族
老宅裡找到的畫像。
你看出什麼... 有罪證的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Aside from that
James Rosimier, you
mean? No! I don't see
anything wrong with
this picture at all.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
除了那個
詹姆斯·羅西米爾，
你是說？不！我看
這幅畫完全沒問題。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Take a good look
at the pocketwatch
in the portrait. That's
the pocketwatch you
wear today, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好好看看畫像裡的
懷錶。那就是
你今天戴的
懷錶，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
...!!!

[{0}]
You might not have caused
the downfall of the Rosimiers
yourself, but with the aid of
the Rekenber Corporation, I'd
say it was entirely possible!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也許你並沒有親手
導致羅西米爾家族的覆滅，
但藉助雷肯貝爾公司的力量，
我認為這完全有可能！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Well played, adventurer.
Well played. I don't regret
what I did: they killed my
Allysia! If James didn't betray
her, if only he didn't drive
her to commit suicide...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
幹得好，冒險者。
幹得好。我不後悔我所做的一切：
他們殺死了我的艾莉西亞！
如果詹姆士沒有背叛她，
如果他沒逼得她自殺就好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's where you're wrong!
Allysia was killed, she didn't
commit suicide. Take a good
look at this note right here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你錯了！
艾莉西亞是被殺的，
她並沒有自殺。
好好看看這張紙條！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
What?!
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
什麼？！

scripts.text: Show James's Note
scripts.translation: 展示詹姆士的紙條

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
What does this prove?
This doesn't show that
James didn't betray Allysia.
How does this change anything?
She's dead, nothing I can do
will bring her back to me!
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
這能證明什麼？
這並不能證明
詹姆士沒有背叛艾莉西亞。
這改變不了什麼。
她已經死了，
我做什麼都無法讓她回到我身邊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I never said James didn't
betray her. Look at the date
on the note. James made plans
to run away with her on August
20th. However, her body was
found on the same day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我從未說過詹姆士沒有背叛她。
看看紙條上的日期。
詹姆士計劃在8月20日
和她私奔。然而，
她的屍體是在同一天被發現的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ergo, Allysia must have
died on August 19th. If she
was planning to run away with
her love on the next day, then
she had no reason to kill herself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因此，艾莉西亞一定是在8月19日死的。
如果她計劃第二天
和她愛的人私奔，
那麼她就沒有理由自殺！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
No, that's not right!
She probably couldn't
trust me! She must have
realized she was nothing
but another toy to him!
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
不，不對！
她大概是不信任我！
她一定意識到
自己只是他的又一個玩物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh yeah? I say she jumped
into the river because you
met her on that day. Now,
take a good look at this!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦？我認為她跳河
是因為你那天見了她。
現在，好好看看這個！

scripts.text: Show K.H.'s note
scripts.translation: 展示K.H.的紙條

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This note was  written by
a man with your initials,
K.H. These initials were also
signed on her portrait. You
must have written this note:
there's too many coincidences!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這張紙條是由
一個署名K.H.的人寫的。
這些首字母也簽在
她的畫像上。
一定是你寫的這張紙條：
巧合太多了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
According to this note,
you told Allysia that you
wanted to see her again
at the place you first met.
I think you did see her again...
on August 19th, the day she died!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
根據這張紙條，
你告訴艾莉西亞你想
在你們第一次見面的地方
再見她一次。
我想你確實又見了她...
在8月19日，她死亡的那天！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm assuming the place you
two first met was near the
river. No more of your lies:
Tell me what really happened!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我推測你們第一次見面的地方
在河邊。別再撒謊了：
告訴我到底發生了什麼！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Hah... Ha ha ha...
Yes... That's right...
That horrible night.
I remember it well...
.....................

[Kiel Hyre]
That night, when she came
to the river to meet me as
I had asked, I begged her to
run away with me, instead
of waiting for that James.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
那天晚上，當她來到河邊
見我，正如我所要求的，
我懇求她跟我私奔，
而不是等那個詹姆士。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
She insisted that James
never betrayed her, and he
promised to take her away
with him the next day. Can
you imagine how that made
me feel? I was nothing to her.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
她堅持說詹姆士
從未背叛過她，
並承諾第二天會帶她走。
你能想像那讓我
感覺如何嗎？我對她來說什麼都不是。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
My feelings didn't matter to
her at all! She kept fidgeting
with that ring...I lost control
and tried to take that damned
thing away from her, and
throw it into the river...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我的感情對她來說
一點都不重要！她一直襬弄著
那枚戒指...我失控了，
試圖奪走那該死的東西，
把它扔進河裡...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
But you know what?
She struggled, she actually
fought me! It was just a small
fight, but then, before I knew
it, the ground underneath us
collapsed and... the rains...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
但你知道嗎？
她掙扎了，她真的和我打了起來！
雖然只是一場小衝突，但就在我還沒反應過來時，
我們腳下的地面突然塌陷了... 還有那場雨...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I'm not sure what it
was. The rain weakened
the ground, something went
wrong... and she just... just...
The river swallowed her...
I felt empty. She was gone.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我不確定發生了什麼。
雨水讓地面變得鬆軟，出了點意外...
而她只是... 只是...
被河水吞沒了...
我感到一片空虛。她不見了。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You already know that
she was found dead the
next day. But what really
broke my heart was that
she held that ring so tightly
in her hand, even in death...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
你肯定已經知道了，
第二天人們發現了她的屍體。
但真正讓我心碎的是，
直到死後，她的手裡都緊緊握著那枚戒指...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
His family had everything
while I had nothing. And
he had the audacity to take
Allysia away from me?!
How could that be right?
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
他的家族擁有一切，
而我一無所有。
而他竟然有膽量把艾莉西亞從我身邊奪走？！
這怎麼可能公平？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Even though she had passed
away, I still wanted to prove
to Allysia what kind of ugly
person James really was.
That was when I joined the
Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
即使她已經去世了，
我仍然想向艾莉西亞證明，
詹姆士究竟是個多麼醜陋的人。
就在那時，我加入了雷肯貝爾公司。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I designed the very first
First Generation Robot, which
I named Allysia, and sold the
designs to Rekenber. I gave them
robots, and they gave me money,
power, obedient subordinates.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我設計了第一代機器人，
並給它取名為艾莉西亞，
然後將設計圖賣給了雷肯貝爾。
我給他們機器人，他們給我金錢、
權力，以及順從的部下。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Of course I knew they'd use
my robots for spying and killing!
But you know what? It didn't
matter so long as they gave me
the means to my revenge. It was
the perfect partnership, really.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我當然知道他們會用我的機器人
進行間諜活動和殺戮！
但你知道嗎？只要他們給我
復仇的手段，這就無所謂了。
這真是一段完美的合作關係。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You've got me right
where you want me.
Who are you working
for, and what exactly
do you want? My designs?
My death? Everything...?
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
你把我逼到了牆角。
你是為誰工作的？
你到底想要什麼？我的設計圖？
我的命？還是所有的一切...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I just want
to ask about the nature
of your professional
relationship with the
Rekenber Corporation.
And about Kiehl.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我只是想問問
你和雷肯貝爾公司
之間的職業關係。
還有關於基爾。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kiehl, eh? After hearing
my crazy story, I'm guessing
that you already suspect the
truth about him... He's also
a robot, specifically the first
of the Second Generation models.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
基爾，是嗎？
聽完我這段瘋狂的故事，
我猜你已經懷疑到他的真相了...
他也是一臺機器人，
具體來說，是第一臺第二代型號。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
His mind was developed using.
an experimental, and unstable,
form of the Condensed Magic
Spell Scrolls. He was the only
Second Generation robot that
I was allowed to keep.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
他的思維繫統是基於一種
實驗性且不穩定的
濃縮魔法卷軸開發的。
他是唯一一臺
我被允許保留的第二代機器人。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I've become very attached
to Kiehl. It's not surprising,
seeing that robotics have
become my life. I even raised
him as my own son, and taught
him everything about robotics
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我對基爾產生了很深的感情。
這並不奇怪，
畢竟機器人技術已經成為我生命的一部分。
我甚至把他當作自己的兒子撫養，
並教給他所有關於機器人技術的知識。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kiehl is now a genius,
and has even developed the
Third Generation of robots.
Unfortunately, I failed to
properly raise him with
human morals and ethics.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
基爾現在是個天才，
甚至開發了第三代機器人。
不幸的是，我沒能
用人類的道德和倫理
正確地教育他。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
He's been transforming
the Third Generation robots
into killing machines. That's
why I tried to put them all
into the academy, so they
could learn human behavior.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
他一直在將第三代機器人
改造成殺戮機器。
所以我試圖把它們都送進學院，
讓它們學習人類的行為。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Although the academy
has delayed Kiehl's plans,
he has succeeded into
converting all of the robots
into uncontrollable engines
of mass destruction.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
雖然學院延緩了基爾的計劃，
但他還是成功地將所有機器人
轉化成了不可控的
大規模毀滅引擎。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Yes, he's been working
closely with Rekenber.
Their true objective is to
create killing machines
for Rekenber's use.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
是的，他一直在與雷肯貝爾
密切合作。
他們的真正目標是
為雷肯貝爾製造殺戮機器。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You know all the secrets
of my past now. I'm not
upset with you or anything,
but I do have something
that I want to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
你現在知道了我過去的所有秘密。
我對你並不生氣，
但我有一件事想請求你。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Please! Stop Kiehl!
I don't want his madness
to destroy any more robots!
I see each and every one
of them as one of my children!
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
求你了！阻止基爾！
我不希望他的瘋狂
再毀掉更多的機器人！
我把它們每一個都視為我的孩子！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I know that I must take
full responsibility for all
that has happened. I promise
to take any punishment for
my actions once everything
has been resolved.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我知道我必須為
所發生的一切承擔全部責任。
我承諾，一旦事情解決，
我會接受對我行為的一切懲罰。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Nod
scripts.translation: 點頭

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Thank you so much!
You can find Kiehl
in the underground
level in this mansion.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
非常感謝你！
你可以在這棟宅邸的
地下層找到基爾。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
He stays in the old room
where he was created, but
he reconstructed it as some
kind of cave to keep everyone
out, including me. Yes, he
doesn't trust anyone anymore...
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
他待在他被創造出來的
那個舊房間裡，但他把那裡
改造成了某種洞穴，
以阻止任何人進入，
包括我。是的，
他不再信任任何人了...

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
When you find him, I want
you to take Allysia's ring
out of his heart. If you
remove it, that should stop
him from going berserk.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
當你找到他時，
我要你取出他心臟裡的
愛麗絲亞的戒指。
如果你把它取出來，
應該就能阻止他進入狂暴狀態。

scripts.text: Allysia's Ring?
scripts.translation: 愛麗絲亞的戒指？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Yes... Her ring is the
beginning of everything
I put that in his heart so
that I'd never forget what
the Rosimiers did to me.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
是的...她的戒指是
一切的開端。
我把它放在他心臟裡，
是為了讓我永遠不要忘記
羅西米埃一家對我做的事。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
I think Kiehl's grown
so powerful that normal
weapons might not work
on him anymore. Use this
device that will cause his
power supply to fluctuate.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
我覺得基爾已經變得
非常強大，普通的武器
可能對他不起作用了。
使用這個裝置，
它會導致他的電源波動。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
If you successfully attach
this to Kiehl's body, then
he won't be able to use his
body's full power. While he's
weakened, open up his chest
and get the ring from his heart.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
如果你成功地將這個
裝置安裝在基爾身上，
他就無法發揮身體的
全部力量。趁他虛弱時，
開啟他的胸腔，
從他的心臟裡取出戒指。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Let me know once
you're ready. Then, I'll
guide you Kiehl's room.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
當你準備好時告訴我。
然後，我會指引你
前往基爾的房間。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Are you ready
to confront
Kiehl now?
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
你現在準備好
面對基爾了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
There... the secret
passage is open now.
Just go to the right of
me, but be careful. Kiehl
is extremely dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
那裡...秘密通道
現在打開了。
走到我的右邊，
但小心點。基爾
極其危險。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Please take your
time. I imagine that
it won't be easy.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
請慢慢來。
我想這不會容易。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You're back...!
So were you able
to retrieve Allysia's
Ring from Kiehl's heart?
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
你回來了...！
那麼，你成功從基爾
的心臟裡取出了
愛麗絲亞的戒指嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
You mean... You don't have it?
Please, retrieve Allysia's Ring
from Kiehl's heart!
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
你的意思是...你沒有拿到？
求你了，從基爾的心臟裡
取出愛麗絲亞的戒指！

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wh-what happened...?
Kiehl developed a new
body for himself? Th-that
would make him a Fourth
Generation robot. I had
no idea he was this smart.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
什...發生了什麼...？
基爾為自己開發了
新的身體？那...那
意味著他變成了第四代機器人。
我沒想到他這麼聰明。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Wait, now that I think about
it, I did see robot bodies that
looked like Kiehl when I was
locked in the factory. So he
was using those copies to
develop personal upgrades.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
等等，現在想想，
當我被鎖在工廠裡時，
確實看到過看起來像基爾的
機器人身體。所以
他一直在利用那些複製品
來開發個人升級。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Here, please take this
Keycard which will let you
enter and investigate the
deepest levels of the factory.
I'll investigate Kiehl's room.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
給你，請拿著這張
門禁卡，它可以讓你
進入並調查工廠的最深層。
我會去調查基爾的房間。

scripts.text:
[Kiel Hyre]
Kiehl is my responsibility...
No matter what the cost may
be, I've got to stop him! Oh,
and here, please take this
with my thanks for all of
your help, {0} {1}.
scripts.translation:
[基爾·海爾]
基爾是我的責任...
無論付出什麼代價，
我都必須阻止他！哦，
還有，請收下這個，
以感謝你對我的所有幫助，
{0} {1}。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Who are you?
How did you get here?
Go away
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
你是誰？
你怎麼進來的？
滾開

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
You must be surprised
by everything that's been
happening. Maybe everything
would be easier to understand
if I explained about robots?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
您一定對最近發生的一切感到驚訝吧。
也許如果我解釋一下關於機器人的事，
一切就會更容易理解了？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The robots you've been
encountering are automated
mechanical puppets that can
independantly think and operate.
Many sages have tried to develop
their own robots, but have failed.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
您遇到的機器人是自動化的機械傀儡，
它們能夠獨立思考和運作。
許多賢者都曾嘗試開發自己的機器人，
但都失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
My master, Kiel Hyre, has
been studying robotics since
he was twenty years old, and
has developed three different
generations of robots, the first,
second, and third generations.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
我的師父基爾·海爾從二十歲起就開始研究機器人學，
並開發了三種不同世代的機器人，
分別是第一代、第二代和第三代。

scripts.text: First Generation
scripts.translation: 第一代

scripts.text: Second Generation
scripts.translation: 第二代

scripts.text: Third Generation
scripts.translation: 第三代

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
I am a good example of one
of Kiel Hyre's First Generation
robots. I was constructed using
a heavy mechanical framework,
a robotic heart, and chemically
synthesized skin covering.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
我就是基爾·海爾第一代機器人的一個典型例子。
我由沉重的機械框架、機械心臟
以及化學合成皮膚覆蓋層構成。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
My central processing unit,
equivalent to your brain, is
essentially a Memory Scroll
based on the design of the
Magic Spell Scrolls that you
adventurers use in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
我的中央處理單元，相當於你們的大腦，
本質上是一種記憶卷軸，
其設計基於你們冒險者在戰鬥中使用的魔法卷軸。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
I'm the oldest type of
humanoid robot, so I weigh
a lot, and my mind can only
process a limited amount of
data. Therefore, I can't express
emotion similarly to a human.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
我是最古老型別的人形機器人，所以體重很重，
而且我的思維只能處理有限的資料。
因此，我無法像人類那樣表達情感。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The First Generation robots
were developed from mostly
mechanical parts, but the
Second Generation robots
incorporated Homunculus
science and technology.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
第一代機器人主要由機械部件開發而成，
但第二代機器人融入了生命體科學和技術。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Second Generation robots
are more life-like since they
have artifically created skin
and flesh, although they still
are constructed from a heavy
mechanical framework.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
第二代機器人擁有人工製造的皮膚和肌肉，
因此更具生命感，
儘管它們仍然由沉重的機械框架構成。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Sage elemental scroll
technology was also used
to develop the Condensed
Memory Scroll, a central
processing unit superior to that
used in First Generation robots.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
賢者的元素卷軸技術也被用於開發濃縮記憶卷軸，
這是一種比第一代機器人使用的中央處理單元更優越的部件。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Although Condensed Memory
Scrolls were 100,000 times
more powerful than ordinary
Memory Scrolls, they were
problematic and were prone
to too many error problems.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
雖然濃縮記憶卷軸比普通記憶卷軸強大10萬倍，
但它們存在缺陷，容易出現過多的錯誤問題。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Second Generation robots
were capable of expressing
human-like emotion, but their
production halted after six
years because they were
considered faulty.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
第二代機器人能夠表達類似人類的情感，
但由於被認為存在故障，
在六年之後停止了生產。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Third Generation robots
were mostly designed by
Kiel Hyre's son, Kiehl,
and don't use a mechanical
framework at all: the entire
body is basically a homunculus.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
第三代機器人主要由基爾·海爾的兒子基爾設計，
完全不使用機械框架：
整個身體基本上就是一個生命體。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
With their organic bodies
and advanced artificial hearts
made from imitation Ymir Heart
Pieces, they can experience
physiologic phenomena
just like ordinary humans.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
憑藉它們有機的身體和由仿尤米爾心臟碎片製成的先進人工心臟，
它們可以像普通人類一樣體驗生理現象。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Kiehl was able to develop
a more stable form of the
Condensed Memory Scroll
which does not suffer from
critical errors, and can be
cheaply mass processed.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
基爾開發出了更穩定的濃縮記憶卷軸形式，
它不會遭受嚴重錯誤，並且可以廉價地大規模處理。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Elly is actually a Third
Generation prototype. Once
we optimize the prototypes,
we will begin mass production.
In fact, the academy is our
prototype testing ground.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
艾莉實際上是一個第三代原型機。
一旦我們優化了原型機，
我們將開始大規模生產。
事實上，學院就是我們的原型機測試場。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
The fact that out prototype
robots can interact just like
real humans is proof of our
success in robotics.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
我們的原型機器人能夠像真正的人類一樣互動，
這證明了我們在機器人學上的成功。

scripts.text:
[Allysia]
Please let me know if
you'd like to learn more
about Kiel Hyre's robots.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉西亞]
如果您想了解更多關於基爾·海爾的機器人的資訊，
請告訴我。

scripts.text:

the mansion, something
smashed the top of your
head, and you instantly
lose consciousness...
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你走出豪宅時，
有什麼東西砸中了你的頭頂，
你瞬間失去了意識...

scripts.text:

and a mysterious woman
standing in front of you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你醒來時，
頭痛欲裂，
一位神秘的女子正站在你面前。^000000

scripts.text:
[??????]
Hm? Oh, you're awake
earlier than I thought.
You must feel confused,
but listen carefully. If you
don't, then I can't guarantee
your safety, okay? Alright.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
嗯？哦，你醒得比我預想的要早。
你現在一定很困惑，
但請仔細聽。如果你不聽，
我就無法保證你的安全，明白嗎？好吧。

scripts.text:
[??????]
All you need to know it
that I'm a secret agent for
the Schwarzwald Republic
government. We're investigating
abnormal activity between Kiel
Hyre and the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
你只需要知道，
我是修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國政府的特工。
我們正在調查基爾·海爾與雷肯貝爾公司之間的異常活動。

scripts.text:
[??????]
We saw you enter the
mansion and speak to
Kiel Hyre, so basically
you're here for questioning.
Now tell me the truth. How
do you know Kiel Hyre?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我們看到你進入了豪宅，
並與基爾·海爾對話，
所以基本上你在這裡是為了接受詢問。
現在告訴我實話。
你如何認識基爾·海爾？

scripts.text: I'll tell you everything!
scripts.translation: 我會告訴你一切！

scripts.text: I don't know nuthin'!
scripts.translation: 我什麼都不知道！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Don't...know...nuthin'?
You sure about that? Only
a select few can even speak
with Kiel Hyre in person. You
must have some connection
to him. I'm right, aren't it?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
不...知道...什麼？
你確定嗎？
只有極少數人才能與基爾·海爾親自對話。
你一定與他有某種聯絡。
我說得對，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[??????]
Are you trying to protect
him? I think that you might
not understand what kind of
person you're really dealing
with here. I'll tell you what
I've learned about him...
scripts.translation:
[??????]
你是在試圖保護他嗎？
我覺得你可能並不真正瞭解你正在打交道的這個人。
我來告訴你我所瞭解到的關於他的資訊...

scripts.text:
[??????]
Kiel Hyre. CEO of the
Kiel Hyre Foundation,
manufacturer of various
machinery. His company started
as a small Einbroch store whose
technology slowly grew famous.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
基爾·海爾。基爾·海爾基金會的CEO，
各種機械裝置的製造商。他的公司最初是艾音布羅克的一家小商店，
其技術逐漸變得聲名遠揚。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Rekenber Corperation offered
a merger with the Kiel Hyre
Foundation. We're still not
sure why they wanted Kiel
Hyre in particular to repair
and develop their Guardians...
scripts.translation:
[??????]
雷肯貝爾公司提議與基爾·海爾基金會合並。
我們仍不確定他們為何特別希望基爾·海爾來修復和開發他們的<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛...

scripts.text:
[??????]
We're also not sure why
they wanted to suddenly
focus more on Guardian
development. Then, all
of a sudden, Kiel Hyre's son
appears from out of nowehre.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我們也不確定他們為何突然更加專注於<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛的開發。
然後，基爾·海爾的兒子突然從不知名的地方出現了。

scripts.text:
[??????]
It's very suspicious.
There's no records of his
birth or anything. Still, maybe
Kiel Hyre really did have him
with his secretary, Allysia.
Well, no one is really sure.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
這非常可疑。
沒有他的出生記錄或任何相關資訊。不過，也許基爾·海爾確實與他的秘書艾莉西亞生下了他。
嗯，沒有人真正確定。

scripts.text:
[??????]
In any case, Kiel Hyre's
son and heir, Kiehl, helped
his father establish this
special academy as their
way of giving back to society.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
無論如何，基爾·海爾的兒子和繼承人基爾，
幫助他父親建立了這所特殊的學院，
作為他們回饋社會的方式。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Almost every corporation and
organization tried to get their
spies to enter this academy,
but all of them were rejected.
it's strange. At least one of
them should have made it in.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
幾乎每家公司和組織都試圖派間諜進入這所學院，
但所有嘗試都被拒絕了。
這很奇怪。至少應該有一個成功進入。

scripts.text:
[??????]
And recently, Kiehl Hyre
has held a secret meeting with
Rekenber executives to announce
his new project. He intends to
create advanced humanoid robots
that will replace guardians!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
最近，基爾·海爾與雷肯貝爾的高管們舉行了一次秘密會議，
宣佈了他的新專案。他打算創造先進的人形機器人，
以取代<黑暗蒐集者>華麗金屬守衛！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Our spies reported that
Kiel Hyre was nowhere to
be seen at that meeting,
as well as his trusted
secretary, Allysia. He...
He just disappeared!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我們的間諜報告稱，
基爾·海爾在那次會議上不見蹤影，
他的得力秘書艾莉西亞也不在場。他...
他就這樣消失了！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Then, Kiel Hyre pops back
in his mansion after all
this time as if nothing
happened! At the same time,
Kiehl disappears, under the
excuse of conducting research.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
然後，基爾·海爾在這麼長時間後突然回到了他的豪宅，
彷彿什麼都沒發生過！與此同時，
基爾以進行研究的藉口消失了。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Rekenber is sponsoring
both Kiehl and Kiel, but
there's some kind of conflict
going on between father and
son, I just know it! Now tell
me, what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
雷肯貝爾同時資助基爾和基爾·海爾，
但父子之間似乎存在某種衝突，我確信！現在告訴我，
到底發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[??????]
I'm not sure how well you
know this country, but the
fact that Rekenber is invoved
must tell you that these aren't
good people. Tell me what
you know about them!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
我不確定你對這個國家瞭解多少，
但雷肯貝爾捲入其中，
足以說明這些人絕非善類。
告訴我你知道的一切！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell the woman^000000
^3355FFeverything you know^000000
^3355FFabout Kiel Hyre. Your^000000
^3355FFvoice quivers with sadness^000000
^3355FFwhenever you mention Elly.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你向女子^000000
^3355FF講述你所知道^000000
^3355FF關於基爾·海爾的一切。每當^000000
^3355FF你提到艾莉時，聲音都會因悲傷而顫抖^000000
^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
[??????]
I see, I see...
That poor girl... So...
Your involvement in this
is a coincidence? In that
case, I want your help
in our investigation.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
原來如此，原來如此...
那個可憐的女孩...那麼...
你捲入這件事純屬巧合？既然如此，
我希望你能協助我們的調查。

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[??????]
If you don't cooperate,
then I can't guarantee
your safety, adventurer
scripts.translation:
[??????]
如果你不配合，
我就無法保證你的安全，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? What...?
What does that mean?
Are you threatening me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？什麼...
這是什麼意思？
你是在威脅我嗎？

scripts.text: Just do what she says.
scripts.translation: 照她說的做。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Great.
I'm Agent Mitchell Layla.
From here on, you're working
for the Schwarzwald Republic!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
很好。
我是特工米切爾·萊拉。
從現在開始，你將為修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國效力！

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
I've got some new
information for you.
There's an old lady in
Juno that knew a woman
named Allysia 30 years ago.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
我有一些新情報給你。
朱諾有一位老婦人，
她30年前認識一位名叫艾莉西亞的女子。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
The clincher is that this
Allysia from 30 years ago
commited suicide, and is
identical to Kiel Hyre's
secretary, who is also
named Allysia.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
關鍵證據是，
30年前的這位艾莉西亞自殺身亡，
且與基爾·海爾的秘書長得一模一樣，
那位秘書也叫艾莉西亞。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
This is too much of a
coincidence. I want you to
go to Juno and investigate.
When you're done, talk to
Kiel Hyre's steward, and
he'll send you over to me.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
這太巧合了。我要你去朱諾調查。
完成後，去找基爾·海爾的管家，
他會把你轉介給我。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Yeah, I know.
That guy actually
works for me. Anyway,
when you're ready to go
to Juno, let me know, and you
can board the federal airship.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
是的，我知道。
那個傢伙其實是我的人。總之，
當你準備好去朱諾時，告訴我，
你就可以登上聯邦飛空艇了。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Are you ready?
I'll let you board
the federal Airship so
you can get to Juno, and
finish your mission quickly.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
準備好了嗎？
我會讓你登上聯邦飛空艇，
前往朱諾，儘快完成任務。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Good luck. Once you
complete your mission,
make sure that you report
to Kiel Hyre's steward so
that he can send you to me.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
祝你好運。完成任務後，
記得去找基爾·海爾的管家，
讓他把你轉介給我。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Take your time...
But keep in mind that
I'm not a patient woman!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
慢慢來...
但請記住，
我可不是一個有耐心的人！

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Ah, you're back.
What do you have
to report from your
investigation?
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
啊，你回來了。
你的調查有什麼結果？

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
.....................
Ah, I see. Good work.
Why don't you go speak to Kiel
Hyre and confront him with
what you've learned about
his past? Yeah, grill him.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
.....................
啊，我明白了。幹得好。
不如你去和基爾·海爾對話，
用你瞭解到的他的過去質問他？對，好好盤問他。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Wear this hidden mic,
so we can send help if
you're endangered. I want
you to find out who Kiel
really is, and what's his
relationship to Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
戴上這個隱藏麥克風，
這樣如果你遇到危險，我們可以派人支援。
我要你查清基爾的真實身份，
以及他與雷肯貝爾的關係。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Shouldn't you be
leaving about now?
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
你不該現在出發嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Where did you go,
my darling? Where
are you, my little dear?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你去哪裡了，
親愛的？你在哪裡，
我的小寶貝？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Lullabye...
Say goodnight...
Hush little baby...
Go to sleeeeep~
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
搖籃曲...
晚安...
噓，小寶貝...
快睡吧~

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text: Um, I don't see a baby...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我沒看到嬰兒...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh? My baby won't stop
crying and can't seem
to sleep. She needs to
rest, so I can go to work.
The house is so messy,
and the boss is unhappy...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦？我的寶寶一直哭個不停，
好像睡不著覺。
她需要休息，這樣我才能去工作。
家裡太亂了，老闆也不高興...

scripts.text: Um, I don't see a baby...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我沒看到嬰兒...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
What, she's right--
Well. Darling, what
are you doing? Don't
misbehave in front of
our friend! Shhh, be
good, my little girl.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
什麼，她說得對——
好吧。親愛的，你在做什麼？
別在我們朋友面前搗亂！
噓，乖一點，我的小寶貝。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
What are you...?
Oh, look at that.
You made my little
darling cry! Shhh,
hush, little ^0000FFAllysia^000000.
Go to sleeeeeeep~
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你在做什麼...？
哦，看看你。
你讓我的小寶貝哭了！
噓，安靜點，小^0000FFAllysia^000000。
快睡吧~

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Allysia...?!
Allysia, where did
you go? You were
supposed to come
home a while ago!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
Allysia...？！
Allysia，你去哪裡了？
你應該早就回家了！

scripts.text: Allysia? Isn't she...
scripts.translation: Allysia？難道她是...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou show Allysia's
portrait to the old woman.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向老婦人出示了Allysia的畫像。^000000

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, do you know
Allysia? She's been
missing! She left home
yesterday and hasn't
come back! C-can you
tell me where she is?!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦，你認識Allysia？
她失蹤了！她昨天離家後
就再也沒回來！
你...你能告訴我她在哪嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Don't worry, Allysia...
Mommy will always be
here for you. There's no
need to be sad...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
別擔心，Allysia...
媽媽會永遠陪在你身邊。
不需要難過...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oooh, my legs and back
are so sore. These old
bones ache all over...
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
哎喲，我的腿和背好痠痛。
這些老骨頭渾身都疼...

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a second...
You're carrying too
many items with you
right now, so you'll
need to free up more
Inventory space first...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請稍等...
你現在攜帶的物品太多了，
需要先騰出一些
背包空間...^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Goodness, I hate this
weather! Reminds me
of how old I've gotten!
It chills my bones, it does!
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
天哪，我討厭這種天氣！
讓我想起自己變老了！
真是冷得刺骨啊！

scripts.text: Do you know that grandma?
scripts.translation: 你認識那個老奶奶嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Damn it! If only I didn't
have all those adventures
in my youth! Then maybe
I wouldn't suffer so in
my advanced age!
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
該死！要是我年輕時
沒有經歷那些冒險就好了！
那樣也許我老了就不會
這麼痛苦了！

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh... Yes. She was
the mother of my best
friend, ^3355FFAllysia^000000. Ever since
she commited suicide, things
haven't been the same. Her
mother lost her sanity...
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
哦...是的。她是
我最好的朋友^3355FFAllysia^000000的母親。
自從她自殺後，一切
都不再一樣了。
她的母親失去了理智...

scripts.text: Was ^3355FFAllysia^000000...?
scripts.translation: ^3355FFAllysia^000000是...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh, Allysia was such
a beautiful girl. So many
men wanted her, especially
that dashing James Rosimier.
I remember hearing that they
were going to get married...
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
哦，Allysia是個
非常美麗的女孩。
很多男人追求她，尤其是
那位英俊的James Rosimier。
我記得聽說他們
要結婚了...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
I was so happy for her!
But then, all of a sudden,
she killed herself. Well,
that's what they all say.
Even today, I'm still not
sure what happened.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
我當時為她感到高興！
但突然之間，
她自殺了。至少
大家都這麼說。
直到今天，我仍然
不確定發生了什麼。

scripts.text: Wait, who's James Rosimier?
scripts.translation: 等等，James Rosimier是誰？

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh, James belonged to
one of the oldest and richest
families in Juno. Everything
was going great for them, but
some time after Allysia died,
the family went bankrupt.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
哦，James屬於
朱諾最古老、最富有的
家族之一。他們一切都
很順利，但在Allysia死後
不久，家族就破產了。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
The city manages their
old residence now. For
some reason, they decided
to entrust me with the master
key to the Rosimier Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
現在城市接管了
他們的舊宅。
不知為何，他們決定
把Rosimier宅邸的
主鑰匙交給我保管。

scripts.text: May I borrow the Master Key?
scripts.translation: 借用主鑰匙

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Well, I'm really not
supposed to give it to just
anyone, but I can tell that
you're working with Allysia's
best interests at heart.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
雖然按規定我不應該隨便把鑰匙借給任何人，但我能感覺到，你是真心為了艾莉西亞的利益著想的。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
However, you've got to
make sure that you return
it to me before the people
from City Hall ask me for it.
Alright then, I hope you find
what you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
不過，你一定要在市政廳的人來找我之前把鑰匙還給我。
好了，希望你能找到你要找的東西。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Please hurry and find
whatever you're searching
for in the Rosimier Mansion.
I might get in trouble if
the people from City Hall
come and ask me for the key...
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
請快點在羅西米爾宅邸裡找到你要找的東西。
如果市政廳的人來找我索要鑰匙，我可能會惹上麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Oh, you're finished
searching the mansion?
Depressing, isn't it?
The creditors basically
ransacked everything
a very long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
哦，你搜完宅邸了嗎？
真令人沮喪，不是嗎？
很久以前，債主們就已經把這裡翻得底朝天了。

scripts.text: Why did ^3355FFAllysia^000000...?

[Old Lady]
Well, I know that James
and Allysia were in love,
and he promised to marry
her. Now, supposedly his
family already betrothed
him to another woman.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
嗯，我知道詹姆斯和艾莉西亞是相愛的，他也承諾要娶她。但據說他的家族已經為他許下了另一門親事。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Time went by, and he
was forced to marry his
fiancee. Allysia was pretty
devastated. I think maybe
that's what she... you know...
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
時間一天天過去，他被迫娶了那位未婚妻。艾莉西亞非常痛苦。我想，也許就是因此...你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Listen, if you want to learn
more about what happened,
then I think you should talk
to the ^3355FFfisherman that lives^000000
^3355FFsouth of the Kiel Hyre Academy.^000000
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
聽著，如果你想了解更多
關於這件事的真相，
我想你應該去和
^3355FF基爾·海爾學院南邊^000000
^3355FF住著的漁夫^000000談談。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
He's the one that found
Allysia's body in the river,
so he might have a better
idea of what had happened.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
就是他發現了艾莉西亞的屍體，所以他可能對當時發生的事有更清楚的瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Old Lady]
Yep, Rain's coming.
Can feel it in my bones.
scripts.translation:
[老婦人]
沒錯，要下雨了。
我的骨頭都感覺到了。

scripts.text:
That mansion seems to have
been destroyed by the time.
However, the door looks like
it'd be still operational if
you had the right key.
scripts.translation:
這座宅邸似乎已經隨著時間流逝而破敗不堪。
不過，如果你有正確的鑰匙，大門看起來應該還能開啟。

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a second...
You're carrying too
many items with you
right now, so you'll
need to free up more
Inventory space first...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請稍等...
你現在攜帶的物品太多了，
需要先騰出一些
背包空間...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's nothing here
of importance to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡沒有什麼對你重要的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine the table,
and find a framed portrait
inside the open drawer.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你檢查了桌子，在開啟的抽屜裡發現了一幅鑲框的肖像畫。^000000

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
These days, it's much
harder to catch and fish.
Ever since they built
this factory, the fish
have started to change,
and they look different too...
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
最近，捕魚變得困難多了。
自從建了那座工廠，魚就開始變異，
樣子也變了……

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Eh? You want something?
Heh, youngsters! I know
how much you love handouts,
but you're not getting any.
Now, if you bring me some
Raw Fish, I'd be more friendly~
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
嗯？你想要什麼？
嘿，年輕人！我知道你們喜歡白拿東西，
但我可不會給。不過，如果你給我帶些生魚片，
我會更友善一點~

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Oh, is all this fish
for me? Heh, how very
generous of you. If you're
going to be so kind, then
I suppose I have to repay
the favor. Ask me anything~
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
哦，這些魚都是給我的？
嘿，你真是大方。既然你這麼客氣，
那我得回報一下。儘管問我吧~

scripts.text: 30 years ago, a woman killed herself...
scripts.translation: 30年前，有個女人自殺了……

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Oh? Ohh. Oh yeah.
I remember that. Yeah.
it was August 20th, my
wife's birthday. That day,
instead of catching fish,
I caught a dead woman.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
哦？噢。噢，是的。
我記得那件事。是的。
那是8月20日，我妻子的生日。那天，
我沒有捕到魚，卻撈上來一具女屍。

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Of course, I reported it
to the Juno Police!  They told
me she killed herself since
she was betrayed by her lover,
who also happened to be her
employer. Really tragic stuff.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
當然，我立刻報了朱諾警察！
他們說她是自殺，因為她被情人背叛了，
而那個人恰好也是她的僱主。真是悲慘的故事。

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
Anyway, when they were
moving her body out of the
river, her hand dropped
some ring. I picked it up,
hoping to sell it later for
some zeny. I know, I know...
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
總之，當他們把她的屍體從河裡拖出來時，
她的手掉出了一枚戒指。我撿了起來，
想著以後賣掉換點Zeny。我知道，我知道……

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
I was pretty lucky the
police didn't see me take
it. Later that day, some guy
came up to me and offered
me a lot of money for it.
I guess it was my lucky day!
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
我很幸運警察沒看到我撿走它。
那天晚些時候，有個傢伙找到我，
出高價買下了它。我想那是我的幸運之日！

scripts.text:
[Fisherman]
I found out later that he was
some mechanical repairman--
something. He sold everything
to buy that ring, so I guess
he wanted it desperately.
Then he just dissapeared.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
後來我才知道，他是個機械修理工之類的。
他賣掉了所有東西來買那枚戒指，看來他非常渴望得到它。
然後他就消失了。

scripts.text: Do you remember his name?

scripts.text:

It was something like...
Heil? Hyre? Anyway, it

[漁夫]
他的名字……？
好像是……
海因？海雷？總之，那是很久以前的事了。噢，
他的老房子還在。

Solid Iron Pieces.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你費力地將堅固的鐵片的一端
插入門縫，試圖撬開門。
縫隙稍微變大了一點，
但你弄斷了一塊堅固的鐵片。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWith a mighty heave,
you pry a Solid Iron
Piece into the door jamb,
and fling the door wide open
Unable the withstand the
awesome force, this Solid
Iron Piece shatters into dust.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你用力將堅固的鐵片
插入門框，猛地將門推開。
堅固的鐵片無法承受這股巨大的力量，
瞬間粉碎成塵。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIf only you had a Solid
Iron Piece you could use to
pry open this door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF要是有一塊堅固的鐵片，
就能把這扇門撬開了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFLet's look for something
heavy we can use to pry
open this door.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF讓我們找點重東西，
用來撬開這扇門。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis {0} is far
to weak for what you're using it for
and breaks.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個{0}太脆弱了，
根本承受不住這種用途，
直接斷了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe large door
is wide open, and.
you may now enter.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大門已經大開，
你可以進去了。^000000

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
^3355FFWho knows what is on the
other side of this door. Let's
think about it before barging in..^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF誰知道門後面是什麼。
在衝進去之前，
還是先想想吧。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is open.^000000

^3355FFThis large door..
is closed shut.
If you listen carefully,
you can hear the door
hinges slightly squeak.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這扇大門...
緊閉著。
如果你仔細聽，
能聽到門軸發出輕微的吱呀聲。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis large door..
is closed shut.
If you listen carefully,
you can hear the door
hinges slightly squeak.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這扇大門...
緊閉著。
如果你仔細聽，
能聽到門軸發出輕微的吱呀聲。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a second...
You're carrying too
many items with you
right now, so you'll
need to free up more
Inventory space first...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請稍等...
你現在攜帶的物品太多了，
需要先騰出一些
背包空間...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I'm surprised you made
it this far, adventurer~
I bid you welcome to my
humble room. I assume that
you've come for the Condensed
Memory Scroll... my mind.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
沒想到你能走到這一步，冒險者~
歡迎來到我的房間。我想你是為了濃縮記憶卷軸...也就是我的大腦而來的吧。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
You can understand
why I can't let you have it,
so if you really want the
Condensed Memory Scroll,
then show me what you've got!
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
你應該明白我為什麼不能把它給你。
如果你真的想要濃縮記憶卷軸，
那就讓我看看你的實力吧！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Hmpf! You're pretty good.
Father must have spent
a lot of money to hire
you. So has he sent
you to kill me?
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
哼！你還挺厲害的。
神父一定花了不少錢僱你。
所以，他是派你來殺我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kiel Hyre sent me to ask
you to stop turning all of
the Third Generation robots
into killing machines! How
can do something like that
to other robots like you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
基爾·海爾派我來，
是讓你停止將第三代機器人
改造成殺戮機器！
你怎麼能對像你一樣的其他機器人
做出這種事？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Why not? It's said that man
was made in the image of God.
Well, robots were made in the
image of man. You humans kill
each other as much as you
like, as far as I can tell.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
為什麼不行？據說人類是按上帝的形象創造的。
那麼，機器人就是按人類的形象創造的。
據我所知，你們人類
想怎麼互相殺戮都可以。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
It might not be ethical
for me to provide weapons
to humans that need them...
But that's what they are.
Weapons. It's more humane
for robots to fight than humans.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
對我來說，把武器提供給需要它們的人類
可能並不符合倫理...
但那就是武器。讓機器人戰鬥
比讓人類戰鬥更有人道。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Robots don't naturally
feel pain or emotions...
Not unless they're specially
programmed. Sorry, but I don't
plans to stop what I'm doing.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
機器人天生不會感到疼痛或情緒...
除非經過特別程式設計。抱歉，但我
沒有停止手頭工作的計劃。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I am sorry, but I don't have a plan to stop what I am doing.
Aside from that, my father showed me a great example of
how far a human could go for his own selfinishness by destroying a family.
And therefore I don't think that he could create better robots than mine.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
很抱歉，但我沒有停止手頭工作的計劃。
除此之外，我的父親向我展示了一個很好的例子，
說明人類為了自己的自私可以走多遠，甚至毀滅了一個家庭。
因此，我認為他創造不出比我更好的機器人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Humankind may not be
perfect, but think about
who you're working with!
Rekenber is the epitome of
human evil! How can you
support them like this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人類也許並不完美，但想想
你是在和誰合作吧！
雷肯貝是人性之惡的極致！
你怎麼能這樣支援他們？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I've had a long relationship
with Rekenber. I'm fully aware
of their capabilities. Do you
remember the first room you
passed on your way here, the
one with all the toys?
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
我和雷肯貝有著長期的關係。我完全
瞭解他們的能力。你還記得你來的路上
經過的第一個房間嗎，
那個擺滿玩具的房間？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I bet you didn't know that there
were 5 Second Generation
robots. Me, and my four other
brothers and sisters. Father
built that room so that all
five of us could live together.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
我敢打賭你不知道那裡有
5個第二代機器人。我，以及我的
四個兄弟姐妹。父親建造那個房間，
是為了讓我們五個能住在一起。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I was the only one to
survive. I returned to
Father and even got a
name. But yes, I know
how bad Rekenber really is...
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
只有我活了下來。我回到了
父親身邊，甚至得到了一個名字。但沒錯，我知道
雷肯貝有多壞...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I don't... I don't want
to talk about this any more.
You've made me... Just leave.
I think I will let you live.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
我...我不想再談這個了。
你讓我...快走吧。
我想我會讓你活著的。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Freeze!
Kiehl Hyre, you're
under arrest for creating
and trading illegal weapons!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
站住！
基爾·海爾，你因製造和
非法交易武器而被逮捕！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Ah, Schwarzwald Republic
agents. Heh. I haven't had
this many guests before.
Well, I guess this means
we'll have to fight after
all, you and I. *Sigh* Pity.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
啊，修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的特工。呵。我以前
沒接待過這麼多客人。
好吧，看來我們
終究還是要打一架了，你和我。*嘆氣* 真遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
First, in all fairness,
let me take care of these
nuisances. They're just
mindlessly doing their
jobs--sort of like robots-- but
don't worry, they won't be hurt.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
首先，為了公平起見，
讓我先處理掉這些麻煩。他們只是在
盲目地執行任務——有點像機器人——
但別擔心，他們不會受傷。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Nooooo!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
不——！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
And now, you and I can
have a proper duel, human.
I'm interested in seeing just
how strong you really are~
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
現在，你和我可以
來一場真正的決鬥了，人類。
我很好奇，你究竟有多強~

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
D-damn...!
Well played, adventurer.
Well played. I should have
known that Father would send
the very best after me. Still,
you've failed to truly defeat me.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
該死...！
幹得漂亮，冒險者。
幹得漂亮。我本該知道
神父會派最強的人來對付我。不過，
你並沒有真正擊敗我。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I still have a few
trump cards left
I think... I'll take you
to hell with me... Well,
if robots can go there~
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
我還有幾張
王牌沒出呢
我想...我會帶你
一起下地獄...好吧，
如果機器人也能去那裡的話~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
No...! We're locked
in the room! We're...
We're trapped in here!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
不...！我們被鎖
在房間裡了！我們...
我們被困在這裡了！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Yay~ Let's burn
everything down~
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
耶~ 讓我們
把這裡燒個精光~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Quick, {0},
use Kiel Hyre's power
device, the one that's
supposed to mess with
Kiehl's power supply!
Hurry, use it right now!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
快，{0}，
使用基爾·海爾的
電力裝置，那個
專門用來干擾基爾
電源的裝置！
快，現在就用！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Wh-what? I c-can't
move! This day is just
full of surprises. Oh, well.
I guess it's time for me to
use my other trump card.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
什...什麼？我動
不了了！今天真是
充滿了驚喜。好吧。
看來是時候讓我
使出另一張王牌了。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
What...?
How many trump
cards do you have?
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
什麼...？
你到底還有多少
張王牌？

scripts.text:
[????]
I'm so disappointed...
I can't believe none
of you thought of this.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
真讓人失望...
真不敢相信
你們竟然沒想到這一點。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Who are you...?
Show yourself!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
你是誰...？
出來吧！

scripts.text:
[????]
Please.
Don't insult me.
You know this voice.
It's been talking to
you this entire time~
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
拜託。
別侮辱我。
你認識這個聲音。
它一直在和你說話~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Impossible...
How can there
be two of you...?!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
不可能...
怎麼會有
兩個你...？！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Hahahahaha!
I'm a robot!
I can make extra
bodies, switch brains
with them. It's awfully
convenient, let me tell you.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
哈哈哈哈！
我是機器人！
我可以製造
額外的身體，並與它們
交換大腦。相信我，
這非常方便。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Anyway, I don't mean to show
off, but I suppose I better
reveal to you my final trump
card. First of all, I know all
about you, Ms. Mitchell Layla~
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
總之，我不想
炫耀，但我想我最好
向你展示我的最後一張
王牌。首先，我對你
瞭如指掌，米切爾·蕾拉小姐~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
What? How do you
know my name?
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
什麼？你怎麼
知道我的名字？

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Well, I have a few
spies of my own...
I'll allow him to explain...
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
嗯，我也有
幾個間諜...
我讓他來解釋吧...

scripts.text:
[Masked Man]
Mitchell...
I'm sorry that
you had to get
involved in all this...
scripts.translation:
[蒙面男子]
米切爾...
很抱歉
讓你捲入了這一切...

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Wolkeus? Wolkeus Kaiser?!
You're the spy?! But you risked
your life to save our president!
No! Oh, God! How can this be
happening?! Everything's just...
This is all crazy! All of it!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
沃爾凱烏斯？沃爾凱烏斯·凱撒？！
你是間諜？！但你曾
冒著生命危險救了我們的總統！
不！天哪！這怎麼可能
發生？！一切都...
這太瘋狂了！全都是！

scripts.text:
[Wolkeus]
This is just the result
of elaborate plans that
were made years ago. I didn't
expect you to be this surprised,
Mitchell. It's the way the game
is played. You know that.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾凱烏斯]
這只是多年前
精心策劃的結果。我沒想到
你會這麼驚訝，米切爾。這就是
遊戲的規則。你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Mister President...
I failed you... I'm sorry...
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
總統先生...
我辜負了您...對不起...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Well, Kaiser, she took
it pretty badly, but at least
you're being gentlemanly
about it. Well, I'd like for
all of us to get better
acquainted, but...
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
嗯，凱撒，她雖然反應很激烈，但至少你表現得像個紳士。我想大家應該多熟悉一下，但是...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
We'd better say our
farewells here. This
place will be gone in
five minutes. Ah, and
Ms. Layla, you're coming
with us. We have questions~
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
我們最好在這裡告別了。這個地方五分鐘後就會消失。啊，對了，蕾拉小姐，你要跟我們走。我們還有問題要問~

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I'm curious as to what
the president's plans are.
Mister Kaiser, if you'll
escort Ms. Layla, please...
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
我很好奇總統的計劃是什麼。凱撒先生，麻煩你護送一下蕾拉小姐...

scripts.text:
[Wolkeus Kaiser]
...............................
Sorry, Mitchell.
I gotta do it.

[Mitchell]
No, get away! Let me go!
Let go of me, Wolkeus!
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
不，放開我！讓我走！
放開我，沃爾凱烏斯！

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Great, we're done with
that ugly business. Now,
where was I? Ah, right.
Yes. I'm sorry. We don't
have any more time to play.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
很好，那件醜事結束了。那麼，我剛才說到哪了？啊，對了。
是的，抱歉。我們沒時間再胡鬧了。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Here, adventurer.
I'm aware that my father
sent you here to get this.
Consider it my final gift
to him. I'm surprised he left
this ring inside me, though...
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
給你，冒險者。
我知道是我父親派你來取這個的。
請把它當作我留給他的最後禮物吧。不過，我有點驚訝他居然把這枚戒指留在我體內...

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
I imagine that it must
be precious to him. But
I wonder why he placed
it inside me? Well, anyway,
I have a message I'd like
for you to deliver to him.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
我想這對他來說一定很珍貴。但我不知道他為什麼把它放在我體內？總之，我有一句話想讓你帶給他。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
First... I guess we
should get rid of this
old thing. It was a good
body, and it's served me
well for 23 years. I'll miss
it. Rest well, old Kiehl.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
首先...我想我們應該處理掉這個舊東西。它是個好身體，也為我服務了23年。我會想念它的。安息吧，老基爾。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Now, this was the body
that my father made.
Please tell him that
this means that we're
no longer related to
each other at all.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
現在，這個身體是我父親製造的。
請告訴他，這意味著我們從此不再有任何關係。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
The body I'm using right now?
I made it myself with the most
advanced technology. Consider
it... a Fourth Generation robot
body if you will. Father will
understand what I mean.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
我現在使用的這個身體？
是我用最新技術自己製造的。
你可以把它看作...第四代機器人身體吧。父親會明白我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
Anyway, please tell him
that, and get his old ring
out of my old robot body,
and then give it to him. For
now, let's get out of here: we
just have 3 minutes to evacuate.
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
總之，請告訴他這些，
然後從我舊的機器人身體裡取出他的舊戒指，
再把它交給他。現在，我們得離開這裡：我們只有3分鐘撤離時間。

scripts.text:
[Kiehl]
You're a worthy opponent,
and a human I respect.
I don't know if we'll meet
again, but who knows?
Anyway, I'll open up the
exit for you. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[基爾]
你是值得尊敬的對手，
也是我所尊重的人類。
我不知道我們是否還會再見面，但誰知道呢？
總之，我會為你打開出口。再見~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou retrieve the
ring from the heart of
Kiehl's old robotic body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你從基爾舊機器人身體的心臟中取出了戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFKiehl's old
robotic body
stands alone,
lifeless and silent.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF基爾的舊機器人身體
獨自佇立，
毫無生氣，一片寂靜。^000000
